syntax.sentenceEn: To provide a useful service, each volunteer must understand the needs of the local audience.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The research which helped develop the material created an opportunity for individual learning.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: Labels for Everyone
readings.passageEn: A volunteer at a small cultural museum noticed that visitors often skipped the longest labels. She asked the audience which information they actually wanted. Their answers helped her develop shorter labels beside the exhibits. The new labels did not remove difficult ideas; they explained one idea at a time. Visitors began asking more questions instead of walking past.

question.promptKo: 새 안내문의 특징은 무엇인가요?
choices: 전문가만 읽을 수 있는 표현을 늘렸다.
어려운 내용을 한 번에 한 가지씩 설명했다.
question.explanationKo: 어려운 생각을 빼지 않고 하나씩 설명했다고 명시되어 있습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The new labels did not remove difficult ideas; they explained one idea at a time.

readings.title: Choosing the Material
readings.passageEn: Our science team had enough money for only a small amount of material. One member wanted the brightest package, but another suggested research before shopping. We tested three samples with the same weight. The least expensive sample held the most weight. That result changed our attitude: appearance could attract attention, but it did not prove that a material was strong.

question.promptKo: 팀의 구매 기준은 어떻게 바뀌었나요?
choices: 겉모습보다 시험에서 확인한 성능을 보게 됐다.
가장 눈에 띄는 포장을 무조건 골랐다.
재료의 강도는 비교할 수 없다고 결론냈다.
question.explanationKo: 가장 싼 시료가 가장 큰 무게를 견뎌 외관만으로 강도를 판단하지 않게 됐습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The least expensive sample held the most weight.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the expense was high, the local council wanted to improve the environment.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: If the equipment is available, the coach can encourage everyone to ride safely.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

readings.title: The Short Ride
readings.passageEn: Our local bus company wanted more people to ride its weekend bus. Posters showed comfortable seats, yet few passengers came. Drivers asked residents about the problem. The bus left before the market opened and returned before shoppers finished. The company changed the schedule without buying new buses. More people used the service because it now matched their plans.

question.promptKo: 이용객이 늘어난 직접적인 이유는 무엇인가요?
choices: 운행 시간이 주민들의 일정에 맞게 바뀌었다.
question.explanationKo: 시간표를 바꿔 주민들의 계획과 맞아졌기 때문에 이용이 늘었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: More people used the service because it now matched their plans.

readings.title: Keeping the Hall Comfortable
readings.passageEn: During a school event, every available heater was switched on. The room soon became too warm, and the extra expense worried the organizer. A student measured the temperature in several places instead of guessing from one corner. Two heaters were enough to provide comfort across the room. The remaining heaters were turned off, reducing the energy the event would consume.

question.promptKo: 학생은 난방 상태를 어떻게 확인했나요?
question.explanationKo: 한 지점의 느낌이 아니라 여러 장소의 측정값을 이용했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: A student measured the temperature in several places instead of guessing from one corner.

syntax.sentenceEn: Because the performance could affect demand, the team decided to focus on quality.
syntax.promptKo: Because로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: because절은 뒤에 나오는 행동이나 상황의 이유를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: To discover how a cell works, the chemistry class examined a proper model.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: Before the Performance
readings.passageEn: Before the performance, Hana worried that her nervous emotion would ruin the evening. Her teacher did not demand that she feel perfectly calm. Instead, they practiced where to look after the first line and when to take a breath. These small actions gave Hana something useful to focus on. She still felt nervous on stage, but she completed her part.

question.promptKo: 연습이 하나에게 준 도움은 무엇인가요?
choices: 긴장을 완전히 없애야만 무대에 설 수 있게 했다.
공연 전에 모든 대사를 바꾸게 했다.
긴장한 상태에서도 집중할 구체적인 행동을 마련했다.
question.explanationKo: 시선과 호흡 같은 작은 행동이 긴장 속에서도 집중할 대상을 주었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: These small actions gave Hana something useful to focus on.

readings.title: A Fair Chemistry Test
readings.passageEn: Two groups in chemistry class wanted to discover which cloth absorbed more water. One group used a large piece and the other used a small piece. Their first results could not settle the issue because cloth size could affect the outcome. They repeated the test with equal pieces. Only then did they compare how much water each material could hold.

question.promptKo: 첫 시험의 결과를 바로 비교할 수 없었던 이유는?
choices: 두 집단이 같은 양의 물을 사용했다.
question.explanationKo: 천의 크기 자체가 결과에 영향을 줄 수 있어 크기를 맞춰 다시 시험했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Their first results could not settle the issue because cloth size could affect the outcome.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the career seemed secure, the novel helped Mina imagine a different profession.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The profession which I hope to enter requires a complex approach to each problem.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: The Missing Package
readings.passageEn: A package began to disappear behind other boxes in the school office. Its owner called several times, but nobody could describe it in enough detail. A clerk introduced a simple approach: every delivery received a numbered sticker and a place on a shelf. The system was not complex. It worked because everyone could contact the office using the same number.

question.promptKo: 새 방식이 효과적이었던 이유는 무엇인가요?
choices: 모두 같은 배송 번호로 물건을 확인할 수 있었다.
배송 상자를 받는 즉시 열어 보았다.
상자를 눈에 띄지 않는 곳으로 옮겼다.
question.explanationKo: 번호라는 공통 기준을 사용해 배송 물건을 정확히 확인할 수 있었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: It worked because everyone could contact the office using the same number.

readings.title: A Different Career Picture
readings.passageEn: Min read a novel about a person whose career changed several times. At first, he thought a secure profession meant doing exactly the same work forever. The character's experience offered another view. Her useful skills remained, even when her workplace changed. Min became aware that learning how to solve a problem could matter more than memorizing one job title.

question.promptKo: 민이 새롭게 생각하게 된 것은 무엇인가요?
choices: 소설 속 경험은 어떤 생각도 바꿀 수 없다.
직업을 바꾸면 이전 능력은 모두 사라진다.
직업 이름보다 문제 해결 능력이 오래 쓰일 수 있다.
한 직장에서만 일해야 능력을 유지할 수 있다.
question.explanationKo: 일터가 바뀌어도 유용한 능력은 남았다는 경험이 민의 관점을 바꿨습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Her useful skills remained, even when her workplace changed.

syntax.sentenceEn: To decrease waste, the biology club will recycle its equipment whenever possible.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: If the publisher can replace the damaged cover, we can publish the account on time.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

readings.title: Borrow Before Buying
readings.passageEn: The biology club wanted new equipment for an experiment. An expert visited the club and asked students to describe what they already owned. They found several usable tools in a cupboard and borrowed the missing item from another class. They did not need to replace everything. Their desire for a fresh start had almost hidden the value of existing resources.

question.promptKo: 동아리가 새 물건을 모두 살 필요가 없었던 이유는?
choices: 전문가가 모든 장비를 버리라고 했기 때문이다.
쓸 수 있는 도구를 찾고 부족한 것은 빌렸기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 기존 물품을 확인하고 대여해 필요한 도구를 마련했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: They found several usable tools in a cupboard and borrowed the missing item from another class.

readings.title: An Honest Account
readings.passageEn: Our newspaper planned to publish an account of the recycling project. The first draft said that waste had fallen every week, but the records showed one increase. We could not describe the change as constant. We included the unusual week and explained that a festival had produced extra rubbish. The less perfect story gave readers a clearer picture of the project.

question.promptKo: 신문이 한 주의 증가를 포함한 이유는?
choices: 기록에 맞는 정확한 경과를 보여 주기 위해서였다.
재활용 사업이 전혀 효과 없다고 주장하려고 했다.
축제 이야기를 기사에서 모두 빼기 위해서였다.
question.explanationKo: 예외가 있던 주까지 설명해야 독자가 사업의 실제 변화를 이해할 수 있었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The less perfect story gave readers a clearer picture of the project.

syntax.sentenceEn: Because the habitat was dry, the species needed a steady supply of water.
syntax.promptKo: Because로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: because절은 뒤에 나오는 행동이나 상황의 이유를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the exchange was brief, it helped the lonely student remain active.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: A Quiet Exchange
readings.passageEn: A lonely student rarely spoke during lunch. His classmates assumed that he preferred being alone, until a partner asked him about music. He liked to compose short songs but felt unsure about sharing them. They arranged a weekly exchange of recordings. The steady routine gave him a reason to join the group without requiring him to speak loudly in a crowded room.

question.promptKo: 정기적인 녹음 교환이 학생에게 준 것은?
question.explanationKo: 시끄러운 곳에서 크게 말하지 않아도 음악을 통해 참여할 수 있게 됐습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The steady routine gave him a reason to join the group without requiring him to speak loudly in a crowded room.

readings.title: The Changed Habitat
readings.passageEn: After an extreme storm, a class examined a small pond habitat. Students expected every species to react in the same way. Instead, some insects gathered near fallen branches while others moved into open water. The teacher asked them to reflect on each change before naming a cause. A single factor might influence different living things differently, depending on how they use the pond.

question.promptKo: 교사가 학생들에게 요구한 태도는 무엇인가요?
choices: 폭풍 이전의 관찰은 모두 버리는 것이다.
한 종만 보고 연못 전체를 판단하는 것이다.
변화를 각각 살펴본 뒤 원인을 판단하는 것이다.
모든 생물이 똑같이 반응했다고 기록하는 것이다.
question.explanationKo: 원인을 단정하기 전에 각 생물의 변화를 따로 검토하도록 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The teacher asked them to reflect on each change before naming a cause.

syntax.sentenceEn: To increase access, the library will allow visitors to request a written response.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The announcement which mentioned electricity helped explain the lack of a firm schedule.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: An Accessible Night
readings.passageEn: The astronomy club was ready to announce a night of star watching. One member noticed that the only telescope stood above several steps. A disabled visitor might have no access to it. The club placed another telescope on the level path and tested the route before opening. The change did not alter the stars, but it changed who could enjoy looking at them.

question.promptKo: 동아리가 망원경을 추가로 놓은 이유는?
choices: 계단을 이용하기 어려운 사람도 관찰하게 하려는 것이었다.
question.explanationKo: 평평한 길에 망원경을 마련해 관찰 기회의 접근성을 높였습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The club placed another telescope on the level path and tested the route before opening.

readings.title: Concentrating in the Library
readings.passageEn: Some students found it hard to concentrate near the library entrance. The librarian first considered a firm rule against all conversation. Before deciding, she asked for a response from regular visitors. They suggested separate quiet and discussion areas. Noise did not disappear completely, but it no longer filled every corner. The library could allow collaboration without removing space for individual study.

question.promptKo: 도서관이 채택한 해결책은 무엇인가요?
question.explanationKo: 공간을 나누어 협력과 개인 공부가 함께 이루어지도록 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: They suggested separate quiet and discussion areas.

syntax.sentenceEn: If the flood damages the bridge, the team must construct a temporary crossing.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: To predict fuel use, the company will combine measurements before the launch.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: The Bridge Model
readings.passageEn: A team had to construct a model bridge using a limited quantity of paper. They did not begin by adding more layers everywhere. They tested how pressure moved through different shapes, then chose where extra support was needed. Their final bridge used less material than an earlier model but held more weight. Careful design had mattered more than simply making the whole bridge thicker.

question.promptKo: 마지막 모형이 더 적은 재료로 버틴 이유는?
choices: 다리 위에 무게를 올리지 않았기 때문이다.
필요한 곳에 지지 구조를 배치했기 때문이다.
모든 곳을 똑같이 두껍게 만들었기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 압력이 전달되는 방식을 시험해 보강할 위치를 정했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: They tested how pressure moved through different shapes, then chose where extra support was needed.

readings.title: Plans for the Launch
readings.passageEn: A club planned to launch a small paper boat during a festival. Heavy rain created a flood threat near the stream, frustrating the organizers. They moved the activity to a shallow indoor pool instead of asking visitors to approach the fast water. The boats traveled a shorter distance, but everyone could see their movement safely. Changing the location preserved the main activity.

question.promptKo: 장소를 바꾼 뒤에도 유지된 것은 무엇인가요?
question.explanationKo: 실내로 옮겨 안전을 확보하면서 배를 띄우고 관찰하는 활동은 유지했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Changing the location preserved the main activity.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the instruction seemed clear, one electronic feature could confuse a new user.

readings.title: One Clear Instruction
readings.passageEn: An electronic display in the community center confused visitors. Its instruction showed six actions at once, although most users needed only the first two. A resident suggested revealing the next action after the previous one was complete. During a second test, more people finished without help. The device had gained no new feature; its existing features had become easier to understand.

question.promptKo: 두 번째 시험에서 이용이 쉬워진 이유는?
choices: 새 기능이 여섯 개 추가됐기 때문이다.
해야 할 행동이 순서대로 표시됐기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 이전 행동을 끝내면 다음 안내를 보여 주어 한꺼번에 처리할 정보가 줄었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: A resident suggested revealing the next action after the previous one was complete.

readings.title: What to Donate
readings.passageEn: Our class wanted to donate supplies to a neighborhood workshop. We planned to collect a wide variety of items, but the workers asked us to check their stock first. They already had many pencils and almost no protective gloves. We changed the collection list. Asking about a real need gave our effort an advantage that a larger, less focused collection would not have had.

question.promptKo: 학생들이 모금 물품 목록을 바꾼 이유는?
choices: 작업장의 실제 부족 물품을 확인했기 때문이다.
보호 장갑을 사용하지 않기로 했기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 연필은 충분했지만 장갑이 부족하다는 정보를 바탕으로 목록을 조정했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: They already had many pencils and almost no protective gloves.

syntax.sentenceEn: Because the tide was rising, the stranger offered to assist us before the disaster grew worse.
syntax.promptKo: Because로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: because절은 뒤에 나오는 행동이나 상황의 이유를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: If we limit interruptions, we can establish a reasonable plan and work more efficiently.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

readings.title: Before the Tide Returned
readings.passageEn: A stranger at the harbor asked our group to leave the rocks. One student felt embarrassed and wanted to argue, but our guide asked for a reason. The rising tide would soon cover the narrow path back to shore. We moved immediately and later thanked the stranger. An unwelcome remark had contained information that could prevent a dangerous mistake.

question.promptKo: 학생들이 바위에서 나온 결정적 이유는?
choices: 돌아갈 길이 밀물에 잠길 예정이었기 때문이다.
낯선 사람이 사진을 찍고 싶어 했기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 밀물이 귀환 경로를 덮을 위험이 있다는 설명을 듣고 이동했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The rising tide would soon cover the narrow path back to shore.

readings.title: A Reasonable Request
readings.passageEn: The art room had a rule that students could not interrupt a demonstration. One afternoon, a student noticed water reaching an electrical cable and called out. The teacher stopped the lesson and asked someone to obtain help. Later, they revised the rule to include urgent safety concerns. An efficient classroom needed a reasonable exception, not silence in every possible situation.

question.promptKo: 수업 규칙은 어떻게 바뀌었나요?
choices: 긴급한 안전 문제는 즉시 알릴 수 있게 됐다.
어떤 상황에서도 말을 못 하게 됐다.
question.explanationKo: 일반적인 방해는 줄이되 긴급한 안전 우려에는 예외를 두었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Later, they revised the rule to include urgent safety concerns.

syntax.sentenceEn: To reduce risk, the guide gave us a specific clue about the edge of the path.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the theory was probable, the independent group wanted to consider another explanation.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: A Clue at the Edge
readings.passageEn: During a practice treasure hunt, our group found a clue near the edge of a garden. The note said to look beside the oldest tree, not to climb it. One player wanted to search the high branches anyway. We decided to consider the specific instruction first. The next envelope lay safely among the roots, and nobody needed to take an unnecessary risk.

question.promptKo: 그룹이 위험을 감수할 필요가 없었던 이유는?
choices: 봉투가 높은 나뭇가지 끝에 있었기 때문이다.
단서가 나무 옆을 가리켰고 봉투가 뿌리 사이에 있었기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 지시대로 나무 옆을 확인하자 뿌리 사이에서 봉투를 찾았습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The next envelope lay safely among the roots, and nobody needed to take an unnecessary risk.

readings.title: Testing the Theory
readings.passageEn: An independent team studied why attendance at a reading club had fallen. Their first theory blamed the choice of books. Interviews offered another clue: several members could no longer reach the meeting after their bus schedule changed. The team moved the meeting later and checked attendance again. The improved result suggested that practical access, rather than dislike of reading, had been the main problem.

question.promptKo: 새 조사 결과가 보여 준 주된 문제는?
choices: 책에 대한 흥미보다 모임에 올 수 있는 시간이었다.
모든 회원이 독서를 싫어하게 된 것이었다.
책을 빌릴 자원이 전혀 없던 것이었다.
question.explanationKo: 버스 시간표가 바뀌어 참석하지 못한다는 단서에 따라 모임 시간을 조정했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: several members could no longer reach the meeting after their bus schedule changed

syntax.sentenceEn: The route which follows the grain fields allows travelers to observe rural life.

syntax.sentenceEn: To acquire a meaningful skill, Mina used part of her salary to purchase a course.

syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: A Route Worth Observing
readings.passageEn: Travelers usually chose the shortest route through our town. A local guide proposed a slower walk past the grain store and the old bridge. She gave a brief explanation at each stop, allowing visitors to observe changes that were easy to miss from a car. The walk took longer, but its value came from noticing places rather than merely reaching the end.

question.promptKo: 이 산책의 가치는 무엇에 있었나요?
choices: 차 안에서만 마을을 보는 데 있었다.
이동 중 지나치기 쉬운 장소를 관찰하는 데 있었다.
최단 시간에 목적지에 도착하는 데 있었다.
어떤 설명도 듣지 않는 데 있었다.
question.explanationKo: 빠른 도착보다 이동 과정에서 장소를 자세히 보는 것이 중요했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The walk took longer, but its value came from noticing places rather than merely reaching the end.

readings.title: A Meaningful Purchase
readings.passageEn: After receiving her first salary, Jiwoo wanted to purchase an expensive notebook for her poetry. Before buying it, she visited a free workshop at the library. The instructor helped her acquire a habit of recording small observations each day. A plain notebook was enough for that work. She still liked beautiful covers, but she now understood that the habit made the writing meaningful.

question.promptKo: 지우가 알게 된 것은 무엇인가요?
choices: 무료 수업에서는 어떤 기술도 배울 수 없다.
일상의 작은 관찰은 시에 쓸 수 없다.
의미 있는 글에는 비싼 표지보다 관찰을 기록하는 습관이 중요하다.
시를 쓰려면 고가의 공책이 반드시 필요하다.
question.explanationKo: 매일 관찰을 기록하는 습관이 글을 의미 있게 한다는 점을 배웠습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: she now understood that the habit made the writing meaningful

syntax.sentenceEn: If the mechanic can seek expert advice, the operation may become a typical repair.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the display looked plain, the committee chose to approve its clear design.

syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: The Rural Display
readings.passageEn: A rural museum wanted a display about farming tools. Its first design surrounded each object with a long technical comment. Visitors looked exhausted before reaching the second case. The museum replaced most of the text with a short story about one typical day's work. People began connecting the tools with real actions, instead of treating them as a series of unrelated objects.

question.promptKo: 전시를 바꾸자 도구가 어떻게 이해되기 시작했나요?
choices: 사용 방법을 알 수 없는 장식품으로만 이해됐다.
전문가만 볼 수 있는 비밀 자료로 이해됐다.
실제 하루의 작업과 연결된 물건으로 이해됐다.
question.explanationKo: 하루의 작업 이야기가 각 도구의 쓰임을 연결해 주었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: People began connecting the tools with real actions, instead of treating them as a series of unrelated objects.

readings.title: The Mechanic's Pause
readings.passageEn: Our bicycle mechanic stopped an operation that seemed almost complete. A small part did not fit as expected. Rather than force it into place, she chose to seek the correct instructions and compare the model numbers. The delay changed our impatient mood. We realized that a careful pause could protect the whole bicycle from damage that a quick finish might cause.

question.promptKo: 정비사가 작업을 잠시 멈춘 이유는?
choices: 부품이 맞지 않아 정확한 지침을 확인하려고 했다.
자전거를 고칠 능력이 없다고 선언하려고 했다.
고객에게 더 비싼 자전거만 팔려고 했다.
이미 모든 작업이 완벽히 끝났기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 맞지 않는 부품을 억지로 끼우지 않고 지침과 모델 번호부터 확인했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Rather than force it into place, she chose to seek the correct instructions and compare the model numbers.

syntax.sentenceEn: To recover the missing file, the committee asked an expert to consult the survey.

syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The facility which offers domestic travel advice helped us arrange our journey.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: A Survey with a Gap
readings.passageEn: A committee used an online survey to decide where a new facility should be built. The results looked accurate because hundreds of answers arrived. Then a member noticed a gap: residents without reliable internet had rarely responded. The committee added paper forms at the market. The new answers did not cancel the earlier ones; they made the overall picture more complete.

question.promptKo: 종이 설문을 추가한 목적은 무엇인가요?
choices: 온라인 조사에서 빠지기 쉬운 주민 의견을 받기 위해서였다.
먼저 받은 답을 모두 없애기 위해서였다.
question.explanationKo: 인터넷 이용이 어려운 주민들이 거의 응답하지 않아 다른 참여 방식을 마련했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: residents without reliable internet had rarely responded

readings.title: Planning the Journey
readings.passageEn: For a domestic journey, our group planned to visit six places in one afternoon. A guide asked us to arrange the stops on a map and attach travel times to each route. The total was longer than the afternoon itself. We removed two stops and left time to rest. A shorter list gave us a more realistic journey, not necessarily a poorer one.

question.promptKo: 두 장소를 일정에서 뺀 이유는?
choices: 지도가 어떤 정보도 제공하지 않았기 때문이다.
이동 시간을 합치니 이용 가능한 시간을 넘었기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 실제 이동 시간의 합이 오후 시간보다 길어 일정을 줄였습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The total was longer than the afternoon itself.

syntax.promptKo: Because로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: because절은 뒤에 나오는 행동이나 상황의 이유를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the witness could reveal the previous event, she refused to suppose what happened next.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: The Borrowed Device
readings.passageEn: A classmate let me borrow a recording device for an urban sound project. I promised to return it the next morning, but a file problem threatened to delay my work. Instead of keeping it without permission, I explained the problem and asked about her schedule. She needed it at noon. We agreed on a new return time that respected both projects.

question.promptKo: 화자가 문제를 해결한 방법은 무엇인가요?
choices: 녹음 자료를 모두 버리고 연락을 끊었다.
상황을 설명하고 상대 일정에 맞춰 새 반환 시간을 정했다.
question.explanationKo: 상대의 필요 시간을 확인해 두 사람의 계획을 고려한 합의를 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: We agreed on a new return time that respected both projects.

readings.title: What the Witness Knew
readings.passageEn: A witness saw a blue bicycle beside the gate shortly before a bag disappeared. People asked her to reveal who had taken it. She could describe the bicycle, but she could not identify its rider or connect it to the missing bag. She refused to suppose more than she had seen. Her careful statement preserved the difference between an observation and a guess.

question.promptKo: 목격자가 지킨 원칙은 무엇인가요?
choices: 직접 본 것과 추측을 구별하는 것이었다.
파란 자전거의 주인이 범인이라고 단정하는 것이었다.
기억나지 않는 내용을 만들어 말하는 것이었다.
question.explanationKo: 본 사실을 넘어서 범인이나 연관성을 추측하지 않았습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Her careful statement preserved the difference between an observation and a guess.

syntax.sentenceEn: To preserve the unique spot, the city decided to adopt a different target for development.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The label which describes the underground room helps visitors imagine an earlier civilization.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: Reading the Label
readings.passageEn: In an underground museum, a small label described a row of ancient containers. It listed dates but said nothing about their use. A visitor suggested adding a drawing of someone carrying water. The new picture helped people connect the objects with daily life in an earlier civilization. The objects had not changed, but the explanation gave visitors a clearer way to understand them.

question.promptKo: 새 그림이 한 역할은 무엇인가요?
question.explanationKo: 물을 나르는 그림이 용기의 생활 속 쓰임을 보여 주었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The new picture helped people connect the objects with daily life in an earlier civilization.

readings.title: Preserving a Unique Spot
readings.passageEn: The town planned to decorate a quiet spot beside the river with bright lights. Residents liked the idea, but an evening walk revealed that many people came there to see the horizon without glare. The town changed its target from maximum brightness to safe, gentle lighting. It could preserve the atmosphere that made the place unique while still helping visitors find the path.

question.promptKo: 조명 계획의 목표가 어떻게 바뀌었나요?
choices: 수평선을 볼 수 없도록 벽을 세우기로 했다.
최대한 밝게 하기보다 안전하면서 은은하게 비추기로 했다.
방문객이 길을 찾지 못하게 하기로 했다.
question.explanationKo: 장소 특유의 분위기를 유지하면서 길을 찾을 정도의 조명을 선택했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The town changed its target from maximum brightness to safe, gentle lighting.

syntax.sentenceEn: If we identify the standard, we can evaluate whether the artificial material is realistic.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: To memorize the principle, the secretary drew a simple scale on the regional map.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: An Automatic Reply
readings.passageEn: A regional office installed an automatic message system. Every request received an immediate reply, which made the service seem efficient. Yet several residents were disappointed because the replies did not identify their actual problem. The secretary suggested a simple distinction: routine requests could use the system, while unusual ones went to a person. Fast answers were useful only when they were also relevant.

question.promptKo: 자동 응답의 한계는 무엇이었나요?
choices: 답변을 보내는 데 항상 한 달이 걸렸다.
직원이 직접 답하는 것을 기술적으로 막지 못했다.
일부 사람의 실제 문제를 알아내지 못했다.
question.explanationKo: 빠른 답변이라도 이용자의 실제 문제에 맞지 않으면 충분하지 않았습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: the replies did not identify their actual problem

readings.title: A Realistic Model
readings.passageEn: Our group built an artificial landscape for a geography display. The mountains looked impressive, but the rivers were wider than nearby towns. A classmate asked us to check the scale. We used the same standard for every distance and rebuilt several parts. The result looked less dramatic, yet it showed the region more realistically. A convincing appearance had not guaranteed accurate proportions.

question.promptKo: 모형을 고친 핵심 기준은 무엇인가요?
choices: 모든 거리에 같은 축척을 적용하는 것이었다.
마을과 산의 위치를 무작위로 바꾸는 것이었다.
question.explanationKo: 각 부분에 동일한 거리 기준을 적용해 실제 비율에 가까워졌습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: We used the same standard for every distance and rebuilt several parts.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the substance had a permanent odor, the team continued to evaluate its impact.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Because we must cooperate during an emergency, every member should fulfill an assigned role.

readings.title: One Request, Many Voices
readings.passageEn: Students could vote on a small grant for a school project. One group requested expensive equipment; another asked for reusable supplies that several clubs could share. Before voting, students examined how each application would benefit people beyond its own group. The shared supplies won. The decision did not mean that equipment was useless, but that cooperation offered more value under the limited budget.

question.promptKo: 공용 물품 제안이 선택된 이유는 무엇인가요?
choices: 한 모임만 사용할 수 있도록 설계됐기 때문이다.
제한된 예산으로 여러 모임이 함께 혜택을 받을 수 있어서였다.
투표 전에 모든 의견이 금지됐기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 여러 동아리가 공유할 수 있는 이점이 한정된 예산에서 중요하게 평가됐습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: cooperation offered more value under the limited budget

readings.title: The Substance Test
readings.passageEn: In a physics demonstration, a dark substance absorbed light and became warm. One student said that its color must guarantee the same result in every situation. The teacher resisted that conclusion and changed the amount of light reaching the sample. Its temperature changed too. The demonstration showed why the impact of one feature should be tested alongside the conditions in which it operates.

question.promptKo: 교사가 빛의 양을 바꾼 이유는 무엇인가요?
choices: 시료를 더 이상 관찰하지 않으려고 했다.
실험에서 빛을 전혀 사용하지 않으려고 했다.
결과가 색 외의 조건에도 영향을 받는지 보이기 위해서였다.
검은색이면 언제나 같은 온도가 된다고 증명하려고 했다.
question.explanationKo: 빛의 양을 바꾸자 온도도 달라져 한 가지 특징만으로 모든 결과를 설명할 수 없었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Its temperature changed too.

readings.title: At the Rainforest Entrance
readings.passageEn: At the entrance to a rainforest exhibit, visitors could choose several paths. The shortest path passed close to a display of small organisms that were difficult to see in a crowd. A guide helped distribute visitors among the routes instead of sending everyone in one direction. Each group had more room to observe, and the location of the smallest exhibit no longer created a crowded bottleneck.

question.promptKo: 안내원이 방문객을 여러 길로 나눈 이유는?
choices: 가장 짧은 길을 영구히 폐쇄하려고 했다.
작은 생물 전시를 보지 못하게 하려고 했다.
모든 관람객을 같은 방향으로 보내려고 했다.
작은 전시 앞의 혼잡을 줄이고 관찰 공간을 확보하려고 했다.
question.explanationKo: 관람객을 분산하자 각 무리가 전시를 관찰할 공간이 늘었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Each group had more room to observe

readings.title: A Hesitant Partner
readings.passageEn: My partner hesitated when I suggested an adventure story for our film. I tried to persuade him by describing exciting scenes, but that did not resolve his concern. He worried about filming outdoors during rainy weather. Once I understood the circumstance, we planned an indoor version of the story. Listening to the reason for hesitation helped more than repeating my original offer.

question.promptKo: 협의가 진행된 전환점은 무엇이었나요?
choices: 상대가 꺼리는 실제 이유를 이해한 순간이었다.
흥미로운 장면을 더 큰 소리로 설명한 순간이었다.
question.explanationKo: 상대의 걱정이 이야기 내용이 아니라 비 오는 날의 야외 촬영임을 알게 됐습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: He worried about filming outdoors during rainy weather.

readings.title: The Autograph Queue
readings.passageEn: After a school symphony concert, a young musician offered to sign programs. The autograph line soon blocked the cabin that stored the instruments. A volunteer suggested moving the line beside the exit and keeping a clear passage for the gear. Nobody lost a chance to meet the musician. A small change in the arrangement protected both the celebration and the work happening behind it.

question.promptKo: 줄을 옮긴 결과로 알맞은 것은?
choices: 만남의 기회를 유지하면서 악기를 옮길 길도 확보했다.
question.explanationKo: 줄의 위치만 조정해 관객의 만남을 유지하며 작업 통로를 비웠습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Nobody lost a chance to meet the musician.

readings.title: An Alternative Investment
readings.passageEn: A student company considered an investment in new packaging. The corporate design looked attractive, but it would cost most of the group's money. An alternative used simple boxes and clear instructions about repair. Customers in a small test preferred the second option because it helped them keep the product working. The group learned that an appealing appearance was only one part of a useful purchase.

question.promptKo: 시험 고객이 두 번째 포장을 선호한 이유는?
choices: 내용물을 볼 수 없게 감쌌기 때문이다.
제품을 한 번만 쓰도록 만들었기 때문이다.
제품을 계속 쓸 수 있게 수리 안내가 도움이 됐기 때문이다.
포장 가격이 반드시 가장 높았기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 수리 안내가 제품의 지속적인 사용에 도움을 준다는 이유로 선택했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: it helped them keep the product working

readings.title: The Charity Schedule
readings.passageEn: A charity clinic wanted every infant to receive enough time with its visiting doctor. The first schedule gave each household an identical appointment length. Some families needed an interpreter, however, so their visits took longer. The clinic began asking about language needs before arranging appointments. Treating families fairly required attention to their different situations, rather than assuming that identical time always meant equal help.

question.promptKo: 진료소가 사전에 언어 지원 필요를 물은 이유는?
choices: 통역이 필요한 가정은 받지 않으려고 했다.
모든 진료 시간을 무조건 줄이려고 했다.
의사가 가족과 대화하지 않게 하려고 했다.
가정마다 필요한 진료 시간을 더 적절히 배정하려고 했다.
question.explanationKo: 통역이 필요한 가정은 시간이 더 들기 때문에 이를 일정에 반영했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Some families needed an interpreter, however, so their visits took longer.

readings.title: The Household Refund
readings.passageEn: Our household received a refund for a broken kettle. The shop asked whether we wanted an identical replacement or our money back. We chose the money because we already had another kettle we could use. A broad offer of choices was helpful, but the sensible choice still depended on our own situation. A free replacement would not have been useful merely because it was free.

question.promptKo: 이 가족이 환불을 선택한 이유는?
choices: 이미 사용할 수 있는 다른 주전자가 있었기 때문이다.
새 주전자는 모두 고장 나 있었기 때문이다.
가게가 반드시 두 개를 사라고 했기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 필요한 물건이 이미 있어 같은 물건을 하나 더 받는 것보다 환불이 나았습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: We chose the money because we already had another kettle we could use.

readings.title: Choosing a Destination
readings.passageEn: A travel club chose a destination by looking at beautiful photographs. Before they committed to the trip, a member suggested checking the genuine cost of getting there. Transport was cheap, but the nearest affordable rooms were far from the main sites. They compared the sum of travel and lodging costs with another town. The second destination proved less expensive overall, despite its higher train fare.

question.promptKo: 여행지가 바뀐 이유는 무엇인가요?
choices: 숙박 장소는 전혀 필요 없었기 때문이다.
교통비와 숙박비를 합한 전체 비용을 비교했기 때문이다.
두 번째 도시의 기차표가 더 쌌기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 기차 요금만이 아니라 숙박까지 포함하면 두 번째 목적지가 더 저렴했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The second destination proved less expensive overall, despite its higher train fare.

readings.title: Conserving the Evidence
readings.passageEn: Our class studied a drawing that showed several stages of a plant's evolution in an imaginary world. The artist had changed every feature at each stage, making relationships hard to follow. We suggested conserving one recognizable pattern while allowing other features to develop. The revised sequence made the concept clearer. Readers could track continuity instead of facing a completely unfamiliar image at every step.

question.promptKo: 수정된 그림에서 같은 무늬를 남긴 이유는?
choices: 상상의 세계를 실제 역사라고 주장하려고 했다.
식물의 특징을 전혀 보여 주지 않으려고 했다.
단계 사이의 연속성을 알아볼 수 있게 하기 위해서였다.
모든 단계가 완전히 같다는 뜻을 보이기 위해서였다.
question.explanationKo: 일부 알아볼 수 있는 요소를 유지해 변화 전후의 연결을 이해하도록 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Readers could track continuity instead of facing a completely unfamiliar image at every step.

readings.title: A Clear Invitation
readings.passageEn: The invitation to a formal school ceremony looked elegant, but several guests missed the starting time. The visual design placed a large sculpture in the center and the departure information in tiny letters below it. We made the time and meeting place more distinct. The new version looked simpler, yet it fulfilled the invitation's main purpose: helping people arrive at the right place and time.

question.promptKo: 초대장을 수정할 때 강조한 것은 무엇인가요?
choices: 작은 글씨를 더 작게 만드는 일이었다.
question.explanationKo: 초대장의 실질적인 목적에 필요한 시간과 장소를 더 뚜렷하게 보이도록 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: We made the time and meeting place more distinct.

readings.title: Following the Leak
readings.passageEn: An agriculture class noticed that one portion of a garden stayed unusually wet. Students first blamed the current weather, but the rest of the beds were dry. A careful inspection found a leak where two pieces of pipe met. Repairing that single component solved the problem. A general trend could not explain why only one small area differed from everything around it.

question.promptKo: 날씨가 주된 원인이 아니라고 본 단서는?
choices: 다른 화단은 말라 있고 한 부분만 젖어 있었다는 것이다.
모든 화단이 똑같이 젖어 있었다는 것이다.
파이프가 전혀 설치돼 있지 않았다는 것이다.
검사 전부터 새 파이프를 모두 샀다는 것이다.
question.explanationKo: 날씨는 전체에 영향을 주지만 젖은 곳은 국소적이어서 배관을 확인했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Students first blamed the current weather, but the rest of the beds were dry.

readings.title: A Trap in the Diagram
readings.passageEn: A guide used a diagram to demonstrate an animal trap from an old story. The picture showed a narrow entrance but no way for the animal to leave. One eager visitor asked whether the diagram described a real device or just the storyteller's idea. The guide checked the source and clarified that it was fictional. A detailed picture was not, by itself, evidence that something had existed.

question.promptKo: 안내원이 확인한 것은 무엇인가요?
choices: 그림 속 동물이 실제 전시장에 있다는 것이다.
그림은 실제 장치의 기록이 아니라 이야기 속 설정이었다.
그림이 정교하면 반드시 실제 장치였다는 것이다.
question.explanationKo: 출처 확인을 통해 실제 기록과 허구의 그림을 구분했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The guide checked the source and clarified that it was fictional.

readings.title: Spare Time in a Remote Town
readings.passageEn: During an annual visit to a remote town, my companion planned every minute. An unexpected road closure forced us to pause near a small workshop. We watched an artist repair a wooden toy and learned about the town's history. On our next visit, we left spare time between appointments. A good plan could guide us without preventing every unplanned discovery.

question.promptKo: 다음 방문 계획에 여유 시간을 둔 이유는?
choices: 마을의 역사를 더는 듣지 않으려고 했다.
예상하지 못한 발견을 할 기회를 남기기 위해서였다.
question.explanationKo: 계획이 일정의 안내 역할을 하면서도 뜻밖의 경험까지 막을 필요는 없다고 느꼈습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: A good plan could guide us without preventing every unplanned discovery.

syntax.sentenceEn: Because the laboratory faced a shortage, the chief had to organize a shared schedule.

syntax.explanationKo: because절은 뒤에 나오는 행동이나 상황의 이유를 설명합니다.

readings.title: The Shared Laboratory
readings.passageEn: A laboratory faced a shortage of a measuring tool. The chief did not immediately request more equipment. She asked the teams to organize their bookings and record when the tool was actually being used. Several teams had reserved whole afternoons for brief tasks. Shorter appointments allowed everyone to finish. The problem had involved access to an existing resource, not simply the number of tools.

question.promptKo: 도구 부족을 해결한 핵심 조치는?
choices: 새 도구를 무조건 많이 산 것이다.
실제 사용 시간에 맞춰 예약을 짧게 조정한 것이다.
question.explanationKo: 짧은 작업에 긴 시간을 잡아 두던 예약을 조정해 공동 이용이 가능해졌습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Shorter appointments allowed everyone to finish.

readings.title: A Pause in the Lecture
readings.passageEn: A lecturer explained a complicated process without stopping. Her audience copied every word, but few could describe the main idea afterward. During the next lecture, she added short pauses and asked listeners to explain one step to a partner. These breaks gave them time to digest the information. The session contained fewer slides but produced a clearer understanding of the process.

question.promptKo: 두 번째 강의에서 쉼의 역할은 무엇이었나요?
choices: 들은 내용을 이해하고 정리할 시간을 주었다.
첫 강의보다 슬라이드를 더 빨리 넘겼다.
question.explanationKo: 중간에 멈추고 설명하는 시간이 정보의 이해를 도왔습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: These breaks gave them time to digest the information.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the client was generous, the insurer had to regulate payments for the surgery.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: To thrive as a writer of fiction, she needed discipline and a flexible mindset.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: Beyond the Royal Costume
readings.passageEn: A fiction club wrote a story about a royal family. Their first draft described magnificent clothing but gave the characters no difficult choices. A reader said the setting was fancy while the plot felt empty. The writers added a conflict over a scarce resource and showed how each character responded. The story improved because decisions revealed character more clearly than decoration alone could.

question.promptKo: 이야기가 나아진 이유는 무엇인가요?
choices: 어려운 선택을 통해 인물의 성격이 드러났기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 자원 부족에 대응하는 선택이 외형적 장식보다 인물을 잘 보여 줬습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: decisions revealed character more clearly than decoration alone could

readings.title: A Client's Priorities
readings.passageEn: A generous client offered to finance a new garden bench. She initially chose an expensive design because she liked its fancy appearance. The park staff explained that frequent repairs would require money the park did not have. They compared durability and utility before choosing a simpler bench. The client's gift became more useful when it considered the future care of the object as well as its purchase.

question.promptKo: 더 단순한 벤치를 선택한 이유는?
choices: 아무도 벤치를 사용할 수 없게 하려고 했다.
구매 후 관리 비용과 실제 쓰임까지 고려했기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 겉모습뿐 아니라 내구성과 유용성, 이후 관리 가능성을 따졌습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: They compared durability and utility before choosing a simpler bench.

syntax.sentenceEn: If you measure the cottage carefully, you can apply the correct amount of paint.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The abstract which explains the study helped us confirm a decline in crop yield.
