syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: Reading the Abstract
readings.passageEn: A contemporary science article began with an abstract that seemed to confirm a dramatic discovery. Our class read the full explanation before accepting the claim. The experiment involved only a small number of samples, and the authors said that more tests were necessary. The abstract had summarized a promising result, not settled every question. Careful reading helped us distinguish a possibility from a firm conclusion.

question.promptKo: 학생들이 발견한 연구의 한계는?
choices: 초록이 모든 질문을 최종 해결했다는 것이다.
표본이 적고 추가 시험이 필요했다는 것이다.
question.explanationKo: 초록의 긍정적 요약만으로 확정된 결론이라고 볼 수 없었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The experiment involved only a small number of samples, and the authors said that more tests were necessary.

readings.title: Measuring the Cottage
readings.passageEn: We wanted to apply a new coat of paint to a small cottage. A neighbor estimated the quantity by looking at the building from the road. Another offered to measure each wall and subtract the windows. The second method took longer but produced a more useful estimate. We bought enough paint without a large surplus, confirming the value of a little careful preparation.

question.promptKo: 두 번째 견적 방법의 장점은 무엇인가요?
choices: 창문 면적까지 무조건 두 번 계산했다.
question.explanationKo: 벽 면적에서 칠하지 않을 창을 빼 더 적절한 양을 계산했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Another offered to measure each wall and subtract the windows.

syntax.sentenceEn: To install the display, the pupils must follow the document rather than imitate an alien design.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the spice had an appropriate label, its unusual smell did not tempt every guest.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: The Scholarship Proposal
readings.passageEn: A pupil hoped to win a scholarship for a project about local stories. Her first document listed many impressive activities but did not explain their purpose. A teacher asked her to propose one clear question and connect each activity to it. The revised plan was smaller but easier to understand. It showed how interviews and drawings would work together, rather than merely promising a busy schedule.

question.promptKo: 계획을 고칠 때 가장 중요했던 변화는?
choices: 다른 사람과의 인터뷰를 무조건 금지한 것이다.
인상적인 활동 이름만 더 많이 적은 것이다.
question.explanationKo: 명확한 질문을 중심으로 활동의 목적과 관계를 드러냈습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: A teacher asked her to propose one clear question and connect each activity to it.

readings.title: Signs at the Resort
readings.passageEn: A resort planned to install signs that simply said which activities were prohibited. Visitors often ignored them because they did not understand the reason. New signs explained that a fragile nesting area lay beyond the fence and suggested another path. More guests followed the guidance. The change did not remove the rule; it made the rule's purpose visible and offered an appropriate alternative.

question.promptKo: 새 표지판이 더 효과적이었던 이유는?
choices: 방문객에게 아무 정보도 주지 않았기 때문이다.
금지 이유와 이용 가능한 다른 길을 설명했기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 보호해야 할 이유와 대체 경로를 함께 알려 주었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: New signs explained that a fragile nesting area lay beyond the fence and suggested another path.

syntax.sentenceEn: If the supervisor can identify the defect, the team can ensure a safer commute.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The virtual address which appears on the receipt is different from the office address.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: The Wrong Address
readings.passageEn: Our club ordered materials through a virtual shop. The receipt showed our old address, although we had entered the new one on the final page. Before abandoning the order, we contacted a supervisor with a copy of both records. The shop identified a defect in its saved address form. Correcting the information before shipping prevented a much longer delay later.

question.promptKo: 배송 지연을 예방할 수 있었던 행동은?
choices: 오류를 보고도 아무 연락을 하지 않은 것이다.
주문을 받자마자 영수증을 모두 버린 것이다.
잘못된 주소로 배송될 때까지 기다린 것이다.
영수증의 주소를 확인하고 출고 전에 기록을 전달한 것이다.
question.explanationKo: 출고 전에 주소 오류를 발견하고 바로잡았습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Correcting the information before shipping prevented a much longer delay later.

readings.title: Comparing the Earthquake Models
readings.passageEn: Students built two model towers for an earthquake demonstration. One group claimed that its design was stronger because the tower appeared wider. A supervisor asked them to compare both models under the same shaking pattern. The wider tower lost a loose upper section first. The class learned to inspect particular weaknesses rather than treating one visible trait as proof of overall strength.

question.promptKo: 실험이 보여 준 것은 무엇인가요?
choices: 눈에 보이는 한 특징만으로 전체 강도를 판단하면 안 된다.
폭이 넓은 탑은 언제나 가장 튼튼하다.
두 모형을 서로 다른 조건에서 시험해야 한다.
question.explanationKo: 넓어 보이는 탑도 느슨한 부분이 먼저 손상돼 세부 약점을 살펴야 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The wider tower lost a loose upper section first.

syntax.sentenceEn: Because the drought was harsh, the agency tried to nurture the remaining plants.
syntax.promptKo: Because로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: because절은 뒤에 나오는 행동이나 상황의 이유를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: To meet the nutrition criteria, the retailer had to revise its contract with the supplier.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: Nutrition on the Contract
readings.passageEn: A student market planned to sell snack boxes. The retail contract focused on price and packaging, but a team member asked about nutrition. They added criteria for clear ingredient information and portion size before choosing a supplier. The boxes remained affordable. The change showed that a purchasing decision could include useful information for customers instead of considering only the cheapest offer.

question.promptKo: 계약에 새로 반영한 기준은?
choices: 재료 정보와 한 번에 제공되는 분량이었다.
가장 싼 제안만 무조건 고르는 조건이었다.
question.explanationKo: 가격과 포장에 더해 소비자에게 필요한 식품 정보를 기준에 넣었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: They added criteria for clear ingredient information and portion size before choosing a supplier.

readings.title: Nurturing the Small Garden
readings.passageEn: During a fictional town-planning exercise, students designed a garden for a place with harsh summers and frequent drought. Their first drawing contained delicate plants that required constant watering. After reviewing the conditions, they chose plants suited to the proposed environment and added shade. The revised garden was less colorful on paper, but the students could explain how they would nurture it with limited water.

question.promptKo: 수정한 정원의 장점은 무엇인가요?
choices: 주어진 환경과 물의 제약 속에서 관리 방법을 설명할 수 있었다.
물을 무한히 사용할 수 있게 됐다.
question.explanationKo: 환경과 물의 한계를 고려해 유지 가능한 설계로 바꿨습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: the students could explain how they would nurture it with limited water

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the noise could interfere with their routine, the council would not deny access to the hall.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The adolescent who became conscious of the problem suggested a temporary solution.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: A Temporary Quiet Hour
readings.passageEn: The student council introduced a temporary quiet hour in a shared study room. During that hour, visitors could read alone; afterward, ordinary conversation was welcome again. The routine helped students who were sensitive to noise without depriving everyone else of a place to talk. A notice explained both times clearly, so people could choose the part of the day that suited their needs.

question.promptKo: 이 규칙이 서로 다른 요구를 배려한 방법은?
choices: 시간을 나누어 조용한 공부와 대화를 모두 가능하게 했다.
question.explanationKo: 시간대를 구분해 개인 학습과 대화 공간의 필요를 함께 반영했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: During that hour, visitors could read alone; afterward, ordinary conversation was welcome again.

readings.title: The Arctic Notebook
readings.passageEn: In a fictional explorer's notebook, an adolescent assistant records an arctic journey. The leader describes only distances and supplies, while the assistant notices sounds, colors, and moments of fear. Neither account can capture the whole experience alone. Read together, they show how a single journey may contain both practical problems and personal responses. Different observers can preserve different parts of the same event.

question.promptKo: 두 기록을 함께 읽을 때 얻는 것은?
choices: 하나의 여정에 관한 서로 보완하는 관점이다.
두 사람이 서로 다른 곳에 갔다는 증거다.
개인의 감정은 기록할 가치가 없다는 결론이다.
question.explanationKo: 실무적 정보와 개인적 경험이 각각 다른 부분을 담아 함께 읽으면 더 넓게 이해할 수 있습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Neither account can capture the whole experience alone.

syntax.sentenceEn: To avoid a barrier, the pedestrian asked a neighbor for directions to the next crossing.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: If we distinguish evidence from tradition, our statement will be more useful during the trial.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

readings.title: An Errand Across Town
readings.passageEn: On a small errand, I discovered that a new barrier blocked the usual pedestrian crossing. A neighbor showed me a safer route through a public square. It took a few minutes longer, but I could cross at marked signals throughout the walk. I wrote the route down for my younger brother, including landmarks rather than relying on a vague instruction to take the next road.

question.promptKo: 화자가 동생을 위해 기록한 길 안내의 특징은?
choices: 눈에 보이는 표식을 포함해 구체적으로 설명했다.
question.explanationKo: 모호한 방향 대신 표식을 넣어 동생이 안전한 길을 찾기 쉽게 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: I wrote the route down for my younger brother, including landmarks rather than relying on a vague instruction to take the next road.

readings.title: A Tradition in Two Voices
readings.passageEn: For a class play about an imaginary tribe, two characters discuss a tradition. One remembers the comfort it offered during a difficult childhood. The other describes an errand that the tradition makes harder today. Their statements are different without being dishonest. The audience must distinguish a person's experience from a complete judgment of the custom, and consider why the same practice can carry different meanings.

question.promptKo: 두 인물의 말에 대한 설명으로 알맞은 것은?
choices: 관습은 모든 사람에게 항상 같은 의미다.
서로 다른 경험에 근거하므로 둘 다 진실할 수 있다.
question.explanationKo: 같은 관습을 다른 경험과 필요에서 바라보므로 상반된 진술이 함께 성립할 수 있습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Their statements are different without being dishonest.

syntax.sentenceEn: Because the infection was widespread, the volunteers worked to protect their peers.
syntax.promptKo: Because로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: because절은 뒤에 나오는 행동이나 상황의 이유를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: To renew the garden, we will adjust the beds and enrich the soil before planting.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: Protecting a Shared Project
readings.passageEn: A gardening team wanted to protect its progress during a week of hot weather. One peer suggested pouring a large amount of water onto every bed at once. Another checked the soil in each section and found that some areas were already wet. The team adjusted the plan to match the different beds. A drastic action across the whole garden was less useful than a careful response to local conditions.

question.promptKo: 팀이 화단별로 계획을 조정한 이유는?
choices: 모든 화단이 똑같이 말라 있었기 때문이다.
물의 양을 확인할 수 없었기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 이미 젖어 있는 구역도 있어 같은 양을 일괄 적용하지 않았습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Another checked the soil in each section and found that some areas were already wet.

readings.title: The Germ Illustration
readings.passageEn: An illustrated story showed a germ as a tiny character carrying a weapon. Younger readers enjoyed the picture, but some thought real germs looked like the character. The artist added a short note separating the imaginary design from a simplified scientific diagram. The story could remain entertaining without presenting its visual invention as a literal description of infection or the things that cause it.

question.promptKo: 작가가 설명을 추가한 목적은?
choices: 상상 속 표현과 실제 설명을 구별하게 하려는 것이었다.
모든 그림이 실제 모습이라고 주장하려는 것이었다.
독자가 이야기를 읽지 못하게 하려는 것이었다.
과학 도표와 캐릭터를 완전히 같은 것으로 만들려는 것이었다.
question.explanationKo: 재미를 위한 의인화 그림을 실제 과학적 모습으로 오해하지 않도록 구분했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The artist added a short note separating the imaginary design from a simplified scientific diagram.

syntax.sentenceEn: The candidate who promised to repair the appliance also explained the cost of the debt.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the crop was small, the representative believed that a shift in methods could help.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: An Oral History of the Crop
readings.passageEn: A community project collected oral accounts of a crop once grown near the town. Older residents described planting times, family meals, and changes in the surrounding ecosystem. Their memories were valuable, but the interviewers also checked dates in written records. The final display placed recollections beside those records, allowing visitors to see both the personal meaning of the crop and the evidence for specific historical claims.

question.promptKo: 전시가 구술 기억과 문서를 나란히 둔 이유는?
choices: 개인적 의미와 역사적 근거를 함께 보여 주기 위해서였다.
모든 기억을 사실이 아니라고 버리기 위해서였다.
문서 기록을 읽지 못하게 하려는 것이었다.
question.explanationKo: 기억의 가치를 살리면서 구체적인 날짜와 역사적 주장은 별도 기록으로 확인했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: the interviewers also checked dates in written records

readings.title: The Candidate's Promise
readings.passageEn: In a mock election, a candidate promised to repair every broken appliance in the school at no cost. Another representative asked who would supply replacement parts. The first speaker admitted that the promise had ignored a real expense. Her revised proposal prioritized urgent repairs and explained the budget. She gained less applause during the speech but more trust during the later discussion.

question.promptKo: 수정한 공약이 신뢰를 얻은 이유는?
choices: 질문을 한 대표를 토론에서 제외했기 때문이다.
고장 난 기구를 모두 숨겼기 때문이다.
비용이 전혀 없다는 주장을 더 크게 했기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 현실적인 비용과 실행 순서를 제시해 검토 가능한 제안이 됐습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Her revised proposal prioritized urgent repairs and explained the budget.

syntax.sentenceEn: If we confront the hardship calmly, we can identify an optimal escape route.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: To avoid misleading readers, the scientist presented the entire solar energy study from a neutral perspective.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: The Solar Comparison
readings.passageEn: For a solar energy exhibit, a team compared two model roofs under a lamp. The entire display suggested that one design always produced the best result. A visitor asked whether the angle of the light had stayed the same. It had not. The team repeated the comparison under matching conditions and revised its initial claim. A valid comparison required controlling the test, not just recording an impressive number.

question.promptKo: 첫 비교에서 확인이 필요했던 조건은?
choices: 가장 큰 숫자를 지울 수 있는지 여부였다.
question.explanationKo: 두 모형에 비추는 각도가 달라 공정한 비교인지 다시 확인해야 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: A visitor asked whether the angle of the light had stayed the same.

readings.title: Beyond the Hero's Beard
readings.passageEn: A student drew a hero with a long beard and an outstanding costume. In the accompanying story, however, the hero escaped every hardship by chance. The class found the pictures memorable but the character difficult to understand. The writer added a scene in which the hero confronted a problem and accepted a cost to help someone else. That choice gave the character more depth than another decorative detail would.

question.promptKo: 영웅에게 깊이를 더해 준 것은 무엇인가요?
choices: 모든 어려움을 우연히 피하게 한 것이었다.
question.explanationKo: 외모가 아니라 어려운 상황에서 내린 선택이 인물을 이해할 단서를 주었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The writer added a scene in which the hero confronted a problem and accepted a cost to help someone else

syntax.sentenceEn: Because the raft struck the ceiling of the cave, the crew had to cease moving forward.
syntax.promptKo: Because로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: because절은 뒤에 나오는 행동이나 상황의 이유를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the craft required minimal equipment, its maker chose to review every step.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: Threads of a Dynasty
readings.passageEn: For an imaginary dynasty in a school play, the costume team gave each family a different thread color. The colors quietly connected characters across several scenes. The design used minimal decoration, yet it helped the audience follow relationships that the dialogue did not always explain. A final review checked that the pattern remained consistent. One small visual choice could unify a complicated story.

question.promptKo: 실 색깔이 한 역할은 무엇인가요?
choices: 모든 인물을 같은 사람으로 보이게 했다.
인물 사이의 가족 관계를 시각적으로 연결했다.
대사의 모든 내용을 대신 읽어 주었다.
question.explanationKo: 일관된 색깔이 대사로 설명하지 않은 관계를 따라갈 수 있게 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The colors quietly connected characters across several scenes.

readings.title: The Raft Workshop
readings.passageEn: At a craft workshop, we built a small raft from reused wood. One board began to soak up water, causing that side to sit lower. Instead of adding decoration to hide the tilt, we stopped and reviewed the construction. Replacing the damaged board restored balance. The workshop reminded us that improving a visible surface cannot repair a weakness in the part supporting it.

question.promptKo: 기울어진 뗏목을 바로잡은 조치는?
choices: 문제를 보지 않으려고 색을 칠한 것이다.
물이 스며드는 손상된 판자를 교체한 것이다.
question.explanationKo: 겉모습이 아니라 균형을 무너뜨린 구조적 원인을 고쳤습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Replacing the damaged board restored balance.

syntax.sentenceEn: The session which explains nutrition includes a moderate amount of information about each ingredient.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: To protect the fragile antique, the museum spent part of its budget on a new case.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: A Session about Ingredients
readings.passageEn: During a budgeting session, students planned a meal for a fictional camping trip. One expensive ingredient used nearly half their money, although it appeared in only a small garnish. They chose a simpler garnish and preserved the main dishes. The revised budget still matched their planned menu. They had not removed every pleasure; they had distinguished an optional detail from the parts needed to feed the group.

question.promptKo: 학생들이 바꾼 것은 무엇인가요?
choices: 주요 요리를 모두 장식으로 바꾼 것이다.
예산을 확인하지 않고 재료를 산 것이다.
비싼 장식을 줄이고 주요 요리는 유지한 것이다.
question.explanationKo: 핵심 식사와 선택적인 장식을 구분해 예산을 조정했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: They chose a simpler garnish and preserved the main dishes.

readings.title: The Fragile Antique
readings.passageEn: A museum guide presented an antique bowl with a visible crack. A visitor asked why the staff had not made it look completely new. The guide explained that the crack formed part of the object's history, while careful support kept it safe for display. The goal was not to erase every sign of age. It was to preserve a fragile object without pretending that time had never touched it.

question.promptKo: 박물관이 추구한 보존 목표는?
choices: 시간의 흔적을 감추지 않으면서 물건을 안전하게 유지하는 것이었다.
모든 옛 흔적을 없애 새 제품처럼 만드는 것이었다.
깨진 그릇을 관람객이 직접 만지게 하는 것이었다.
question.explanationKo: 보존은 모든 노화 흔적의 삭제가 아니라 안전한 유지와 역사 전달을 함께 목표로 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The goal was not to erase every sign of age.

syntax.sentenceEn: If the circular road reduces congestion, traffic may flow more smoothly around the square.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the editorial was vague, it encouraged readers to investigate the obstacle.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: The Circular Market
readings.passageEn: Students designed an imaginary market around a circular square. They placed every popular stall at the same entrance, creating congestion in their model. Moving a few stalls to other sides improved the flow without changing the square itself. The obstacle had been the arrangement of activity, not the shape alone. The class learned to test how people would move through a design before praising its appearance.

question.promptKo: 혼잡의 주된 원인은 무엇이었나요?
choices: 사람들이 어느 곳에도 멈추지 않았기 때문이다.
인기 있는 가판대가 한 입구에 몰려 있었기 때문이다.
광장이 원형이면 이동이 절대 불가능하기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 모양 자체보다 활동이 특정 입구에 집중된 배치가 문제였습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: They placed every popular stall at the same entrance, creating congestion in their model.

readings.title: An Ancestor's Rough Map
readings.passageEn: An ancestor's notebook contained a rough map of fields and a short account of barter. Our family could identify the river, but several other marks were vague. Rather than invent names for them, we compared the map with later records and labeled uncertain points as questions. The investigation remained unfinished, yet it gave us a clearer distinction between what we knew and what we merely suspected.

question.promptKo: 가족이 모호한 표시를 다룬 방법은?
choices: 기록을 비교하고 불확실한 부분은 질문으로 남겼다.
근거 없이 장소 이름을 만들어 적었다.
question.explanationKo: 확인된 사실과 아직 모르는 내용을 구분했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: we compared the map with later records and labeled uncertain points as questions

syntax.sentenceEn: To refresh the display, the museum will portray the ancestor beside the fossil collection.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The opponent who thanked the volunteers seemed grateful despite the miserable weather.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: The Opponent's Thanks
readings.passageEn: After losing a debate, my opponent thanked the volunteers who had organized the room. I had expected a miserable expression or an angry complaint. Instead, she explained that disappointment about a result did not remove her gratitude for other people's work. Her response changed the way I viewed competition. We could oppose an argument strongly without treating everyone involved as an enemy.

question.promptKo: 상대의 행동이 보여 준 태도는?
choices: 상대 의견에 반대하면 반드시 사람도 미워해야 한다.
결과에 실망해도 다른 사람의 노력에는 감사할 수 있다.
question.explanationKo: 결과에 대한 감정과 타인의 수고에 대한 감사를 구분했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: disappointment about a result did not remove her gratitude for other people's work

readings.title: Portraying the Fossil
readings.passageEn: A student artist wanted to portray a fossil animal for an exhibit. The fossil showed some bones clearly, while other parts were missing. She used different shades to separate observed shapes from imagined details. Visitors could enjoy the full picture and still see where evidence ended. The illustration was more informative because it made uncertainty visible rather than hiding it under a confident appearance.

question.promptKo: 그림에서 음영을 다르게 한 목적은?
choices: 관찰된 부분과 상상으로 채운 부분을 구분하려는 것이었다.
모든 부분이 화석에 남아 있다고 주장하려는 것이었다.
그림 전체를 보이지 않게 하려는 것이었다.
발견된 뼈를 없는 것으로 표시하려는 것이었다.
question.explanationKo: 확인된 증거와 재구성한 부분을 시각적으로 구분했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: She used different shades to separate observed shapes from imagined details.

syntax.sentenceEn: Because the pottery had several layers, the workers needed to scan it before removing anything.
syntax.promptKo: Because로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: because절은 뒤에 나오는 행동이나 상황의 이유를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the wage was modest, the apprentice continued to polish each piece with care.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: Layers in the Pottery
readings.passageEn: At a pottery workshop, a visitor admired the radiant surface of a finished bowl. The maker showed an earlier piece with uneven layers beneath its polish. Those layers had caused the surface to crack. She explained that the attractive finish depended on careful work that was no longer visible. The visitor began to value the hidden stages of making the bowl as well as its final appearance.

question.promptKo: 완성된 그릇의 겉모습이 의존한 것은?
choices: 이전 제작 과정을 모두 무시하는 일이었다.
보이지 않게 된 아래 단계의 정성스러운 작업이었다.
고르지 않은 층을 그대로 두는 일이었다.
question.explanationKo: 최종 표면의 품질은 그 아래 층을 잘 만드는 과정에서 시작됐습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: the attractive finish depended on careful work that was no longer visible

readings.title: Choosing a Property
readings.passageEn: Our art class compared two apples for a drawing. One variety had a stronger flavor, but nobody would eat the fruit during this lesson. That property was irrelevant to the task. We chose the apple with clearer patches of light and shadow instead. The exercise helped us justify a choice using a quality connected to its purpose, rather than a detail that mattered only in another situation.

question.promptKo: 그림을 그릴 사과를 고를 때 중요하게 본 것은?
question.explanationKo: 먹는 맛이 아니라 그리는 활동의 목적에 맞는 시각적 특성을 선택했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: We chose the apple with clearer patches of light and shadow instead.

syntax.sentenceEn: To enhance the reception, a colleague offered to transmit a clear map to every guest.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The conference which celebrates her work gives us a chance to acknowledge its merit.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: Welcoming the Colleague
readings.passageEn: At a conference reception, a new colleague stood beside the door while everyone discussed shared memories. Nobody intended to exclude her, but the conversation gave her little chance to join. One organizer asked about her current project and connected it with another guest's work. The small change enhanced the reception more than an elaborate decoration would have. Welcome depended on interaction, not merely on sending an invitation.

question.promptKo: 새 동료가 대화에 참여하게 된 계기는?
choices: 기존 추억만 더 자세히 이야기한 것이었다.
출입문 옆에서 계속 기다리게 한 것이었다.
현재 하는 일을 묻고 다른 참석자의 작업과 연결한 것이었다.
question.explanationKo: 새 참석자가 자신의 경험으로 기여할 수 있는 대화 주제를 마련했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: One organizer asked about her current project and connected it with another guest's work.

readings.title: The Copper Object
readings.passageEn: A small copper object lay among things that a workshop planned to discard. Its surface had darkened, so it seemed to have little merit. An older member recognized it as a tool used by the workshop's founder. They cleaned it carefully and placed it beside a written account of that work. Its importance came from the history people cherished, not from looking new or costly.

question.promptKo: 그 물건의 가치가 새롭게 드러난 이유는?
question.explanationKo: 창립자가 사용한 도구라는 맥락이 외관만으로 보이지 않던 가치를 알려 줬습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: An older member recognized it as a tool used by the workshop's founder.

syntax.sentenceEn: If you follow the procedure with caution, you can reverse the machine's direction safely.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the raw material looked superior, the team needed to test the strength of its bond.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: Testing the Bond
readings.passageEn: Two groups used different materials to bond pieces of a cardboard model. The first group called its result superior because the joint looked neat. The second suggested a common procedure: both models should hold the same small weight for the same length of time. Testing with caution revealed that the neater joint loosened first. Appearance had provided a clue, but not a complete measure of strength.

question.promptKo: 두 모형을 비교한 공정한 절차는?
choices: 한 모형만 시험하고 다른 것은 제외하는 것이었다.
같은 무게를 같은 시간 동안 지지하게 하는 것이었다.
보기 좋은 모형에만 더 가벼운 무게를 주는 것이었다.
접합부를 보지 않고 승자를 정하는 것이었다.
question.explanationKo: 하중과 시간을 같게 해 접합 강도를 비교했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: both models should hold the same small weight for the same length of time

readings.title: A Useful Caution
readings.passageEn: An art teacher gave a simple procedure for cutting paper shapes. The demonstration looked easy, so some students hurried to copy it. She paused to explain why each caution mattered and showed where hands should remain away from the moving tool. Students then practiced slowly under supervision. Understanding the reason for a precaution helped them follow the procedure more carefully than memorizing a warning alone.

question.promptKo: 교사가 주의 사항의 이유까지 설명한 목적은?
choices: 경고를 외울 필요가 없으니 모두 지우려는 것이었다.
도구를 아무 감독 없이 쓰게 하려는 것이었다.
절차를 이해하고 더 신중하게 따르게 하려는 것이었다.
빠르게 따라 하는 경쟁을 시키려는 것이었다.
question.explanationKo: 주의의 이유를 이해하는 것이 말만 외우는 것보다 신중한 행동을 도왔습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Understanding the reason for a precaution helped them follow the procedure more carefully than memorizing a warning alone.

syntax.sentenceEn: To handle the category correctly, the librarian devised a compact strategy for sorting books.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The architecture which attracts visitors also offers a clear view of the wilderness.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: Architecture beside the Wilderness
readings.passageEn: A design class imagined a visitor center beside a wilderness area. One model used a tall tower to attract attention; another kept the architecture low and directed people toward existing paths. The class compared the likely outcome of each plan for both visitors and the surrounding landscape. The quieter design won because the goal was to help people experience the place, not to make the building dominate it.

question.promptKo: 낮은 건물 설계가 선택된 이유는?
choices: 방문객이 자연을 전혀 보지 못하게 하려는 것이었다.
가장 높은 건물이 언제나 안전하지 않기 때문이다.
건물이 주변 장소의 경험을 돕는 것이 목적이었기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 주의를 독점하는 건물보다 주변 장소를 경험하게 하는 설계를 우선했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: the goal was to help people experience the place, not to make the building dominate it

readings.title: The Compact List
readings.passageEn: For a field visit, our group prepared a compact equipment list. We almost omitted a map because everyone carried a phone. A partner asked what would happen if a battery failed. We added a printed map to the shared bag rather than asking every person to bring one. The strategy kept the list short while preserving a useful backup. Compact did not have to mean unprepared.

question.promptKo: 짐을 간단하게 하면서 대비한 방법은?
choices: 여럿이 함께 쓸 종이 지도 한 장을 넣은 것이다.
휴대전화가 절대 고장 나지 않는다고 가정한 것이다.
한 사람마다 큰 장비를 똑같이 준비한 것이다.
question.explanationKo: 공용 예비 지도를 마련해 짐의 양과 대비 필요를 함께 고려했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: We added a printed map to the shared bag rather than asking every person to bring one.

syntax.sentenceEn: Because the vessel had a delicate joint, the crew asked a specialist to restore it.
syntax.promptKo: Because로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: because절은 뒤에 나오는 행동이나 상황의 이유를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the passage was humid, the optimistic guide assured us that the shelter was adequate.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: Restoring the Vessel
readings.passageEn: A craft student tried to restore a broken clay vessel. She wanted the joint to disappear completely, but the instructor asked what the object would be used for. It was a teaching sample meant to show a repair technique. A visible, carefully supported joint served that purpose better. The student learned that an adequate restoration depends partly on the object's intended role, not only on hiding damage.

question.promptKo: 접합부를 보이게 둔 이유는?
choices: 그릇의 사용 목적을 알 수 없었기 때문이다.
수리 기법을 가르치는 표본의 목적에 맞았기 때문이다.
수리를 전혀 할 수 없었기 때문이다.
모든 그릇은 손상을 숨기면 안 되기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 교육용 표본이므로 잘 수리된 접합 부분을 볼 수 있는 것이 도움이 됐습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: It was a teaching sample meant to show a repair technique.

readings.title: An Optimistic Plan
readings.passageEn: We planned a paper decoration for a school event, confident that it would last all afternoon. The hall became humid, however, and the delicate pieces began to bend. An optimistic organizer suggested moving them away from the damp entrance and replacing only the damaged parts. We did not need to restore every piece to its original position. A flexible response kept the event welcoming despite the changed conditions.

question.promptKo: 행사를 유지하기 위해 취한 대응은?
choices: 습한 입구를 피해 옮기고 손상된 부분만 교체했다.
모든 장식을 반드시 처음 자리에 돌려놓았다.
question.explanationKo: 조건의 변화에 맞춰 위치와 필요한 부분만 조정했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: An optimistic organizer suggested moving them away from the damp entrance and replacing only the damaged parts.

syntax.sentenceEn: If the transaction remains stable, the principal concern will be the amount of liquid waste.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: To prepare an edible product, the cook tested a characteristic of the unfamiliar ingredient.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: A Transaction with Information
readings.passageEn: At a pretend school market, teams traded handmade goods using paper tokens. One group recorded only the number of tokens in each transaction. Another also recorded which product had been exchanged and whether a customer requested a change. At the end, the second group could explain its customers' concerns more clearly. Counting sales showed activity; recording the context helped the students understand that activity.

question.promptKo: 두 번째 모둠의 기록에서 얻을 수 있었던 것은?
choices: 첫 모둠보다 항상 더 많은 판매량이었다.
어떤 제품과 요청이 거래에 관련됐는지에 대한 이해였다.
question.explanationKo: 물품과 요청을 함께 적어 숫자 뒤의 맥락을 설명할 수 있었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: the second group could explain its customers' concerns more clearly

readings.title: Listening to the Concern
readings.passageEn: A classmate expressed anxiety about presenting a project. I offered casual advice to stop worrying, but he grew quieter. Another student asked which part concerned him most. He knew the material but was afraid the tablet would fail during his demonstration. We prepared printed diagrams as a backup. Sympathy became more useful when it included listening to the specific concern instead of assuming that every worry had the same cause.

question.promptKo: 구체적인 도움을 줄 수 있었던 이유는?
choices: 발표 자료를 보여 줄 기기의 고장을 걱정한다는 점을 알았기 때문이다.
모든 불안의 원인이 같다고 정했기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 걱정의 실제 원인을 확인해 출력 자료라는 대비책을 마련했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: He knew the material but was afraid the tablet would fail during his demonstration.

syntax.sentenceEn: The tenant who cleaned the pavement also offered to remove weeds from the municipal garden.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the phenomenon appeared infinite, a flexible model could explain its limited duration.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: The Tenant's Proposal
readings.passageEn: A tenant noticed that a broken section of pavement made the route to the municipal garden awkward. She could have sent a vague complaint about the neighborhood. Instead, she marked the location on a map and described who had difficulty passing it. Her specific report helped workers inspect the right place quickly. A worthwhile proposal connected a general concern with details that someone could act on.

question.promptKo: 보고가 바로 점검으로 이어질 수 있었던 이유는?
choices: 다른 사람의 이동과 관련이 없다고 주장했기 때문이다.
위치와 불편을 겪는 사람을 구체적으로 설명했기 때문이다.
동네 전체가 나쁘다는 말만 했기 때문이다.
어디인지 알 수 없는 사진만 보냈기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 행동으로 옮길 수 있는 위치와 영향을 정확히 전달했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: she marked the location on a map and described who had difficulty passing it

readings.title: The Symbolic Door
readings.passageEn: In a story set in an imaginary village, a sacred doorway stands open at every festival. A visitor assumes that the custom means anyone may enter the building at any time. A resident explains that the open door is symbolic, representing a welcome during the ceremony. The visitor learns to ask about a practice's local meaning rather than treating its appearance as a universal instruction.

question.promptKo: 방문객이 처음 오해한 것은 무엇인가요?
choices: 주민이 상징의 뜻을 설명할 수 없다고 생각했다.
의식의 상징을 언제나 적용되는 출입 허가로 받아들였다.
question.explanationKo: 열린 문은 의식 중 환영을 나타내는 상징이지 모든 시간의 출입 허가는 아니었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: the open door is symbolic, representing a welcome during the ceremony

syntax.sentenceEn: To support diverse opinions, the judge asked everyone to revise one part of the proposal.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Because the internal nerve was damaged, the mammal needed prompt treatment.
syntax.promptKo: Because로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: because절은 뒤에 나오는 행동이나 상황의 이유를 설명합니다.

readings.title: Revising the Proposal
readings.passageEn: A class judge had to choose among several designs for a reading corner. Rather than award the prize immediately, she gave each team a prompt describing one practical concern. The teams could revise their proposals before the final decision. This process allowed diverse ideas to improve without forcing them into an identical design. The judge's role included supporting better thinking, not merely ranking the first attempts.

question.promptKo: 수정 기회를 준 목적은 무엇인가요?
choices: 모든 설계를 완전히 똑같게 만들려는 것이었다.
처음 제출한 것을 수정 없이 순위만 매기려는 것이었다.
학생들의 생각을 대신 작성해 주려는 것이었다.
서로 다른 설계가 실용적 문제를 검토하며 발전하게 하려는 것이었다.
question.explanationKo: 한 가지 모양으로 통일하지 않고 각 아이디어의 개선을 도왔습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: This process allowed diverse ideas to improve without forcing them into an identical design.

readings.title: An Iceberg Exhibit
readings.passageEn: An exhibit about an imaginary polar expedition included a large iceberg model and several mammal figures. Flashing lights attracted visitors, but the movement distracted them from the explanation of the animals' routes. The designer reduced the flashing and added a simple moving line. Visitors could follow the intended information more easily. A dynamic display was useful only when its activity supported the idea it was meant to explain.

question.promptKo: 전시의 움직임을 조정한 이유는?
choices: 시각 효과가 핵심 설명을 돕도록 하기 위해서였다.
관람객이 동물의 경로를 보지 못하게 하려고 했다.
깜박이는 불빛을 더 복잡하게 늘리려고 했다.
question.explanationKo: 주의를 빼앗던 효과를 줄이고 설명에 맞는 움직임을 남겼습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Visitors could follow the intended information more easily.

syntax.sentenceEn: If the partial repair fails, the rod may trigger another collapse.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The monologue which reveals the plot includes a deliberate reference to the character's fate.

syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: A Deliberate Pause
readings.passageEn: In a short play, a character gives a monologue about a priceless gift. The actor originally rushed through the final line, leaving the audience unsure why the gift mattered. A deliberate pause before that line changed the scene. It gave listeners time to connect the object with an earlier loss in the plot. No new words were added, but the relationship between existing moments became clearer.

question.promptKo: 마지막 문장 앞의 침묵이 한 역할은?
choices: 관객이 선물과 이전의 상실을 연결할 시간을 주었다.
question.explanationKo: 이미 제시된 사건 사이의 관계를 생각할 시간을 주었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: It gave listeners time to connect the object with an earlier loss in the plot.

readings.title: A Partial Repair
readings.passageEn: A model tower began to collapse during a practice test. The team replaced one broken rod and immediately prepared to celebrate. Their partner asked whether the neighboring joints had also been damaged. A second inspection found another loose connection. The partial repair had solved the visible problem but not every weakness. Their mutual goal was a reliable model, so checking again was part of completing the work.

question.promptKo: 추가 점검이 필요했던 이유는?
choices: 모형을 고칠 목적이 전혀 없었기 때문이다.
눈에 보이는 파손 외에도 다른 연결부가 느슨했기 때문이다.
처음 부러진 막대가 실제로는 멀쩡했기 때문이다.
question.explanationKo: 한 부분의 교체만으로 인접한 손상까지 모두 해결된 것은 아니었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: A second inspection found another loose connection.

syntax.sentenceEn: To complete the assessment, the team examined the vehicle in the context of a real race.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the brochure looked impressive, its crucial information did not match the curriculum.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: Reading the Brochure
readings.passageEn: A course brochure promised an exciting curriculum, but it said little about how learners would demonstrate progress. Before joining, our study group asked for an example assessment and the expected weekly work. The answers gave the bright slogans a practical context. We could then decide whether the course matched our needs. An attractive description became useful when supported by details about what participation actually involved.

question.promptKo: 추가 질문이 도움이 된 이유는?
choices: 홍보 문구의 색깔만 비교할 수 있었다.
과정을 완수하지 않아도 자동 수료된다고 알게 됐다.
실제 과제와 평가를 알아 과정이 필요에 맞는지 판단할 수 있었다.
question.explanationKo: 학습 활동과 평가의 구체적인 정보가 선택의 근거가 됐습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: We could then decide whether the course matched our needs.

readings.title: The Model Vehicle Race
readings.passageEn: Our group entered a model vehicle race and hoped to gain speed by adding a stronger push. A teammate noticed that one wheel rubbed against the deck. Fixing that contact improved the vehicle before we changed the starting force. The result showed why an assessment should examine obstacles as well as possible additions. More input does not automatically help when part of the system is wasting it.

question.promptKo: 속도를 높이기 전에 먼저 해결한 것은?
choices: 밀어 주는 사람의 수가 너무 많은 문제였다.
question.explanationKo: 추진력을 더하기 전에 에너지가 낭비되는 마찰을 줄였습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Fixing that contact improved the vehicle before we changed the starting force.

syntax.sentenceEn: Because the aggressive behavior upset the bystander, the coach postponed the game.
syntax.promptKo: Because로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: because절은 뒤에 나오는 행동이나 상황의 이유를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The blueprint which shows the rear entrance also explains where a new garden can sprout.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: A Bystander's Choice
readings.passageEn: During a rehearsal, one student began to tease another about a small mistake. A bystander noticed that the laughter had become uncomfortable. She interrupted calmly, suggested practicing the difficult part together, and asked the teacher for help when the teasing continued. The rehearsal could remain lively without becoming aggressive. Supporting a classmate did not require turning the situation into another contest of insults.

question.promptKo: 방관하지 않은 학생이 한 행동은?
choices: 함께 연습하자고 제안하고 계속되는 놀림에 교사의 도움을 구했다.
question.explanationKo: 상대를 공격하기보다 연습 방향으로 돌리고 필요한 도움을 요청했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: She interrupted calmly, suggested practicing the difficult part together, and asked the teacher for help when the teasing continued.

readings.title: The Revised Blueprint
readings.passageEn: A workshop team compared its blueprint with the first output of a simple model-making process. The rear section was too narrow because a copied measurement had lost a digit. They corrected the drawing and checked the next model before making several more. The breakdown was useful information about the process, not proof that every part of the plan was worthless. Finding one specific cause made a focused repair possible.

question.promptKo: 팀이 문제를 해결한 방식은?
choices: 검사하지 않고 같은 모형을 계속 만들었다.
잘못 옮긴 치수를 바로잡고 다음 모형으로 확인했다.
question.explanationKo: 원인이 된 치수를 수정하고 확인한 뒤 제작을 이어 갔습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: They corrected the drawing and checked the next model before making several more.

syntax.sentenceEn: To maintain the workshop, we must recruit a patient guide and deliver fresh materials.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the bulletin was brief, it warned us not to overlook the damaged bay.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: A Repair Workshop
readings.passageEn: Mina wanted to recruit three students for a bicycle repair workshop. At first, everyone wanted to paint the bikes, but nobody wanted to maintain the tools. Mina made a chart that gave each student both jobs. By Friday, the tools were clean and two bicycles were ready. The group decided to keep sharing the less popular work.

question.promptKo: Mina가 작업표를 만든 이유는 무엇인가요?
choices: 인기 없는 도구 관리도 함께 맡도록 하려고
question.explanationKo: 학생마다 칠하기와 도구 관리 두 일을 맡겼으므로 덜 인기 있는 일도 나누려는 목적입니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Mina made a chart that gave each student both jobs.

readings.title: An Early Delivery
readings.passageEn: At dawn, Jun arrived to deliver a box of library books. A bulletin beside the door said that the entrance would remain locked until eight. Instead of leaving the box in the rain, he waited under the roof. The librarian thanked him for being patient. Every book was dry when the reading club opened its first meeting that morning.

question.promptKo: Jun이 책 상자를 들고 기다린 까닭은 무엇인가요?
choices: 문이 잠겨 있어 책을 비 맞지 않게 지키려고
question.explanationKo: 문이 열릴 때까지 지붕 아래서 기다려 책을 비로부터 보호했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Instead of leaving the box in the rain, he waited under the roof.

syntax.sentenceEn: If we respect the rule, we can satisfy the lease without creating unnecessary tension.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The substitute who remained calm did not let the hostile crowd discourage the team.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: Room for Another Idea
readings.passageEn: During a group discussion, one student sounded hostile when another proposed a different design. Their teacher asked them to show respect by repeating the other person's idea before answering it. This small rule did not force agreement. It helped them listen. By the end, they had combined two useful suggestions without letting disagreement discourage anyone from speaking again.

question.promptKo: 교사가 제시한 규칙의 핵심은 무엇인가요?
choices: 반박하기 전에 상대의 생각을 다시 말해 듣기
다수의 의견과 다른 말은 하지 않기
question.explanationKo: 상대의 의견을 먼저 되짚어 말하게 하여 존중하며 듣도록 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Their teacher asked them to show respect by repeating the other person's idea before answering it.

readings.title: A Safer Step
readings.passageEn: The gardening club noticed a crack in a concrete step beside its shed. They wanted to fill it quickly, but the caretaker said paint was not a substitute for a proper repair. He closed that path and arranged for help. Students used the other entrance for a week. The bright new paint came only after the step was safe again.

question.promptKo: 수리가 끝나기 전에 학생들이 한 일은 무엇인가요?
question.explanationKo: 갈라진 계단 쪽 길을 닫고 학생들은 일주일 동안 다른 출입구를 사용했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Students used the other entrance for a week.

syntax.sentenceEn: To prevent confusion, the bilingual guide will notify visitors when they must separate into groups.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the renowned speaker had to withdraw, another expert agreed to contribute to the event.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: Two Languages at the Museum
readings.passageEn: A small museum invited bilingual students to contribute to its welcome cards. Hana translated the opening hours, while Luis checked whether the directions were clear. Before printing, they asked the staff to notify them of any changes. Their goal was not to make the cards look impressive. They wanted visitors to find the right room without asking for help.

question.promptKo: 학생들이 안내 카드를 만든 주된 목적은 무엇인가요?
choices: 방문객이 필요한 장소를 쉽게 찾게 하려고
question.explanationKo: 방문객이 도움을 요청하지 않고 알맞은 방을 찾도록 돕는 것이 목적입니다.
question.evidenceQuote: They wanted visitors to find the right room without asking for help.

readings.title: A Photograph from Another Era
readings.passageEn: Our town had a renowned photographer who recorded street life in an earlier era. When the library decided to convert his studio into a gallery, volunteers found several boxes without dates. They kept those pictures separate from the dated ones. Rather than guessing, they asked local residents for clues. The first exhibition included only photographs whose locations had been confirmed.

question.promptKo: 날짜가 없는 사진을 따로 둔 이유로 알맞은 것은?
choices: 확인되지 않은 정보를 함부로 단정하지 않으려고
question.explanationKo: 추측하는 대신 주민에게 단서를 요청하고 확인된 사진만 전시했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Rather than guessing, they asked local residents for clues.

syntax.sentenceEn: Because the folktale described a gigantic fountain, we expected to find something unusual there.
syntax.promptKo: Because로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: because절은 뒤에 나오는 행동이나 상황의 이유를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: If we compare empirical findings, we can develop a coherent account of how the species evolved.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

readings.title: A Peculiar Footprint
readings.passageEn: In a folktale read by our drama club, a peculiar footprint appears outside a village every winter. The villagers first blame a supernatural visitor. A child follows the marks and discovers that the baker's wooden shoe leaves them. Our club kept the mysterious opening but made the final scene funny. The audience learned the answer at the same moment as the villagers.

question.promptKo: 이야기에서 이상한 발자국을 남긴 것은 무엇인가요?
question.explanationKo: 아이가 자국을 따라가 나무 신발이 원인임을 알아냅니다.
question.evidenceQuote: A child follows the marks and discovers that the baker's wooden shoe leaves them.

readings.title: Waiting beside the Fountain
readings.passageEn: A gigantic model bird stood beside the fountain at an outdoor art show. Its moving wings tempted children to chase the shadows across the square. The artist noticed that some visitors could not see from their seats. She stopped the display and moved the chairs into a wider range of positions. question.promptKo: 방문객들이 다음 행사에도 유지하자고 한 것은 무엇인가요?
choices: 더 많은 음료 종류와 빽빽한 좌석
question.explanationKo: 방문객의 추천 내용이 마지막 문장에 직접 제시됩니다.
question.evidenceQuote: When we asked what they would recommend for the next event, most people said to keep the clear menu and comfortable seats.

readings.title: An Auction for the Club
readings.passageEn: Our club had an abundant supply of donated puzzles, including several duplicate copies. We organized a small auction to raise money for new shelves. Before selling anything, we counted the pieces and labeled incomplete boxes honestly. We also arranged a free table to accommodate visitors who did not want to bid. By afternoon, both the auction and the free table had found many users.

question.promptKo: 동아리가 무료 나눔 탁자도 마련한 이유는 무엇인가요?
question.explanationKo: 입찰을 원하지 않는 사람도 행사에 참여할 수 있도록 한 배려입니다.
question.evidenceQuote: We also arranged a free table to accommodate visitors who did not want to bid.

readings.title: Listening after the Concert
readings.passageEn: After a concert in the auditorium, our band asked for feedback on small cards. We expected comments about the songs, but several listeners mentioned that spoken announcements were too quiet. We decided to retain the song order and improve the microphone checks. At the next rehearsal, one member sat at the back and tested whether every announcement could be understood from there.

question.promptKo: 밴드가 받은 의견을 바탕으로 바꾼 것은 무엇인가요?
choices: 안내 방송을 잘 들을 수 있도록 점검을 강화했다
공연 뒤 의견을 받지 않기로 했다
question.explanationKo: 곡 순서는 유지하고 마이크 점검을 개선하기로 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: We decided to retain the song order and improve the microphone checks.

readings.title: The Dusty Model
readings.passageEn: The technology club displayed a model of farm machinery. After several weeks, a buildup of dust made its moving parts hard to see. We realized we had begun to neglect the display after finishing it. Cleaning helped, but we also wrote a weekly care list. We could not undo the delay, yet we could stop the same problem from returning so soon.

question.promptKo: 문제가 빨리 재발하지 않도록 동아리가 한 일은 무엇인가요?
question.explanationKo: 한 번 청소하는 데 그치지 않고 정기적으로 관리할 계획을 세웠습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Cleaning helped, but we also wrote a weekly care list.

syntax.sentenceEn: If the shield is damaged, poor sanitation may impair the quality of the experiment.

syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the metropolitan library was small, its guide gave a fluent explanation of ecology.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?

readings.title: A Garden in the City
readings.passageEn: For an ecology project, our class observed a tiny garden in a metropolitan neighborhood. A fence helped shield the plants from footballs, but its solid panels also hid the flowers from younger children. We proposed a lower section near the path. The gardener agreed to test it in one place first, so the class could watch whether protection and visibility could improve together.

question.promptKo: 낮은 울타리를 한 구간에서 먼저 시험한 이유는 무엇인가요?
choices: 식물 보호와 관람이 함께 나아지는지 살펴보려고
question.explanationKo: 보호 기능과 잘 보이는 정도를 함께 확인하기 위한 작은 시험입니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The gardener agreed to test it in one place first, so the class could watch whether protection and visibility could improve together.

readings.title: The Newspaper Drawing
readings.passageEn: A student drew the interior of a pretend courtroom for our school newspaper. A visiting attorney noticed that the picture left no room for people watching the case. The editor added seats in the margin and checked the labels. The article's coverage was still about a fictional trial, but the corrected illustration helped readers understand who would be in the room and where they might sit.

question.promptKo: 변호사의 지적을 듣고 삽화에 추가한 것은 무엇인가요?
question.explanationKo: 관람하는 사람의 공간이 없다는 지적을 받아 좌석을 덧붙이고 표시를 점검했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The editor added seats in the margin and checked the labels.

syntax.sentenceEn: Because the ripe fruit began to vibrate on the table, we looked for the source of the movement.

readings.title: The Stage Curtain
readings.passageEn: Our drama club built a light wooden foundation for a small model stage. When the table began to vibrate, the fabric curtain kept falling down. We first tried heavier cloth, which made the model harder to carry. Then we fastened the curtain rod more carefully. The same light curtain stayed in place, and the group learned to check the support before replacing the material.

question.promptKo: 커튼이 떨어지는 문제를 실제로 해결한 것은 무엇인가요?
choices: 커튼 봉을 더 단단히 고정한 것
천을 계속 더 무겁게 바꾼 것
question.explanationKo: 가벼운 천을 그대로 두고 지지대를 고친 뒤 커튼이 제자리에 유지되었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Then we fastened the curtain rod more carefully.

readings.title: Sharing the Room
readings.passageEn: Two clubs had an urgent need for the same practice room before a festival. Their conflict grew when both posted full schedules on the door. A teacher suggested a framework with short shared periods and separate quiet work. The students used it to settle the immediate problem. They also agreed to book future dates together, before either club announced them to its members.

question.promptKo: 두 동아리가 앞으로 같은 문제를 줄이기 위해 약속한 것은?
choices: 각자 발표하기 전에 함께 날짜를 예약하기
question.explanationKo: 향후 일정은 일방적으로 알리기 전에 공동으로 정하기로 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: They also agreed to book future dates together, before either club announced them to its members.

readings.title: The Unsigned Note
readings.passageEn: Our literature circle found an anonymous note inside a donated novel. It contained a short quote from the book and a question about the main character. We did not try to identify the writer. Instead, we placed a blank card beside it and invited another reader to respond. Soon the display held several different interpretations, all connected to words that readers could find in the story.

question.promptKo: 독서 모임이 이름 없는 쪽지를 활용한 방법은 무엇인가요?
choices: 다른 독자가 답을 적도록 카드를 마련했다
question.explanationKo: 작성자를 추적하는 대신 독자들이 생각을 이어 쓰는 계기로 삼았습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Instead, we placed a blank card beside it and invited another reader to respond.

readings.title: The Floating Model
readings.passageEn: During a technical project, our group built a model dock for a tray of water. A small anchor was supposed to help it withstand waves from a hand fan. The first anchor slid across the tray. Before we could implement a new design, we recorded what had moved. We then changed only the anchor's shape, keeping the fan speed and dock the same.

question.promptKo: 두 번째 실험에서 다른 조건을 같게 둔 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
question.explanationKo: 다른 조건을 유지하고 한 요소만 바꾸어 닻 모양의 영향을 살펴봅니다.
question.evidenceQuote: We then changed only the anchor's shape, keeping the fan speed and dock the same.

readings.title: The Orchard Sketch
readings.passageEn: A solitary tree stood at the edge of an old orchard. In my first sketch, it seemed to resemble a giant umbrella. My partner saw a dancer instead. We returned to the same place and drew it from two different angles. The shapes looked different again. Neither sketch had to defeat the other; each recorded a particular way of looking at the tree.

question.promptKo: 두 사람의 스케치 경험이 보여 주는 것은 무엇인가요?
choices: 다른 의견은 반드시 하나로 통일해야 한다
같은 대상도 보는 각도에 따라 다르게 보일 수 있다
나무 그림에는 언제나 정답 하나가 있다
question.explanationKo: 같은 나무를 다른 각도에서 보자 모양이 다시 달라져 관점의 차이를 보여 줍니다.
question.evidenceQuote: We returned to the same place and drew it from two different angles.

readings.title: A Clear Signal
readings.passageEn: Our gymnastics club invited a student referee to help with a friendly team event. Before it began, she explained the sequence of turns and showed a flag for stopping. When a loose mat threatened to disrupt a routine, she raised the flag immediately. The team waited while an adult fixed it. Everyone then restarted from the beginning rather than guessing where to continue.

question.promptKo: 매트가 헐거워졌을 때 심판이 한 행동은 무엇인가요?
question.explanationKo: 중단 신호를 즉시 보내고 어른이 매트를 고칠 때까지 기다렸습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: When a loose mat threatened to disrupt a routine, she raised the flag immediately.
