readings.title: Testing the Robot
readings.passageEn: Our club's robot was meant to carry a toy vacuum across a model room. We used blocks to simulate furniture and wrote a hypothesis that a wider turning space would prevent collisions. In the first trial, we also changed the wheel speed. That made the result hard to interpret. For the next trial, we kept the speed constant and changed only the turning space.

question.promptKo: 첫 실험 결과를 해석하기 어려웠던 이유는 무엇인가요?
choices: 회전 공간과 바퀴 속도를 함께 바꾸었기 때문에
question.explanationKo: 공간뿐 아니라 속도도 달라져 어떤 변화가 충돌에 영향을 주었는지 구분하기 어렵습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: In the first trial, we also changed the wheel speed.

readings.title: The Paper City
readings.passageEn: For a class spectacle, we built a paper city with one skyscraper and a tiny fortress. Reed stems supported a bridge between them. The bridge bent when we added too many paper figures, so we removed some and added another support. Our city was imaginary, but the model still had to stand. Visitors enjoyed the little story explaining how its bridge had been repaired.

question.promptKo: 모형 도시의 다리를 고친 방법은 무엇인가요?
question.explanationKo: 무게를 줄이고 받치는 부분을 보강해 휘어지는 문제를 해결했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The bridge bent when we added too many paper figures, so we removed some and added another support.

syntax.sentenceEn: To overcome fatigue, the team will divide the work rather than clone the same task for everyone.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the figures seem to correspond, a hidden bias may obscure the difference between the groups.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: Dividing the Work
readings.passageEn: We tried to divide a long mural into sections for four painters. On the first morning, two sections began to overlap, and rising fatigue made the conversation tense. We stopped to mark the shared edges clearly. Then we agreed that only one person would finish each border. The colors remained varied, but nobody had to paint over another student's work again.

question.promptKo: 벽화 작업에서 역할을 더 분명히 한 부분은 어디인가요?
question.explanationKo: 서로 겹쳐 칠하던 경계는 한 사람만 마무리하도록 정했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Then we agreed that only one person would finish each border.

readings.title: The Orange Peel
readings.passageEn: An odd noise interrupted our cooking club's quiet activity. A nervous beginner had dropped an orange peel and jumped back from it. Our leader laughed at her own first cooking mistake to ease the tension, then asked everyone to clean their work areas. The student stayed and finished the recipe. Having a small job to do helped her overcome the embarrassment without becoming the center of attention.

question.promptKo: 초보 학생이 당황스러움을 이기는 데 도움이 된 것은?
choices: 작은 정리 일을 맡고 활동을 계속한 것
모든 사람 앞에서 실수를 자세히 발표한 것
question.explanationKo: 주목을 강요하지 않고 작은 일로 활동에 다시 참여하게 한 것이 도움이 되었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Having a small job to do helped her overcome the embarrassment without becoming the center of attention.

syntax.sentenceEn: If we enclose the flour in a sealed bundle, we can prevent a measurement error caused by spills.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The garment which has a vertical stripe became the focus of an intriguing experiment.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: A Vertical Test
readings.passageEn: For a classroom experiment, we dropped paper shapes beside a vertical ruler. Each measurement was supposed to begin from the same height, but one student held the shapes higher. We marked a starting line and repeated the trials. The second set of results was easier to compare. The group wrote down the change so that another class could repeat the same procedure accurately.

question.promptKo: 실험에서 출발선을 표시한 목적은 무엇인가요?
choices: 모든 종이 모양을 같은 높이에서 떨어뜨리려고
question.explanationKo: 놓는 높이를 통일해 각 측정 결과를 제대로 비교하도록 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: We marked a starting line and repeated the trials.

readings.title: Packing the Costumes
readings.passageEn: Our drama club needed to send a bundle of costumes to another school. Each garment had a different owner, so we refused to put loose name stickers directly on the cloth. Instead, we would enclose each item in a clean bag and insert a card with its owner's name. A checklist stayed outside the bundle, allowing the receiving teacher to check everything without guessing.

question.promptKo: 이름 카드를 옷에 직접 붙이지 않고 가방 안에 넣은 이유는?
choices: 모든 의상을 같은 사람의 것으로 바꾸려고
question.explanationKo: 옷에 직접 접착물을 붙이지 않으면서 각 소유자를 식별할 수 있게 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Instead, we would enclose each item in a clean bag and insert a card with its owner's name.

syntax.sentenceEn: To comprehend the flaw, the mentor asked us to describe the deed in vivid detail.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the canal looked quiet, the warning sign advised us not to plunge into the water.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: Seeing the Scene
readings.passageEn: My writing mentor said that a vivid scene did not need a long list of adjectives. She asked me to describe what one character noticed while entering a room. I wrote about a cold cup and an unopened letter. My partner could now comprehend why the character felt uneasy, even though I had removed the sentence that directly named the feeling.

question.promptKo: 글을 고친 뒤 독자가 인물의 감정을 이해한 단서는 무엇인가요?
choices: 식은 컵과 뜯지 않은 편지 같은 구체적인 사물
question.explanationKo: 구체적인 장면의 단서로 불안한 감정을 전달하여 직접 감정명을 쓰지 않아도 이해하게 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: I wrote about a cold cup and an unopened letter.

readings.title: Lunch after the Walk
readings.passageEn: After a long walk, our class had a strong appetite. An adult used the grill while students set the table and sliced bread with supervision. One loaf had a very hard crust, so we served it in thinner pieces. Everyone could choose what was comfortable to eat. We came to appreciate the extra care that made a simple shared lunch enjoyable for different people.

question.promptKo: 딱딱한 빵을 더 얇게 썬 이유로 알맞은 것은?
question.explanationKo: 딱딱한 겉부분이 있는 빵도 편하게 먹도록 크기를 조정했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: One loaf had a very hard crust, so we served it in thinner pieces.

syntax.sentenceEn: Because the irrigation system failed, we had to contemplate another way to protect the plants.
syntax.promptKo: Because로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: because절은 뒤에 나오는 행동이나 상황의 이유를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The academic report which examines the underlying norm also questions the superficial explanation.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: Two Ways to Join
readings.passageEn: An outgoing student volunteered to lead our academic discussion group. She preferred quick verbal answers, but noticed that one classmate had good ideas only after a pause. For the next meeting, she offered a minute of silent note writing before anyone spoke. The quieter student then shared a useful question. The group kept both writing and speaking as ways to join the discussion.

question.promptKo: 다음 모임에서 조용히 메모할 시간을 준 이유는 무엇인가요?
choices: 생각을 정리할 시간이 필요한 학생도 참여하도록
question.explanationKo: 말하기 전에 생각을 정리할 시간을 마련하여 참여 방식의 폭을 넓혔습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: For the next meeting, she offered a minute of silent note writing before anyone spoke.

readings.title: The Garden Shelter
readings.passageEn: Our garden shed became a refuge from a sudden shower during an irrigation project. Some students felt drowsy after carrying heavy watering cans, so we paused instead of rushing to finish. Our teacher called the project a shared endeavor, not a race. When the rain stopped, we checked the paths and resumed the work in smaller groups with lighter loads of water.

question.promptKo: 비가 그친 뒤 학생들이 일을 재개한 방식은 무엇인가요?
choices: 작은 모둠으로 나누고 물의 무게를 줄였다
question.explanationKo: 길을 확인한 뒤 작은 모둠과 가벼운 짐으로 부담을 낮춰 작업을 이어갔습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: When the rain stopped, we checked the paths and resumed the work in smaller groups with lighter loads of water.

syntax.sentenceEn: The primitive carriage was inspected by a transport specialist before the museum reopened.
syntax.promptKo: 이 문장에서 수동태가 나타내는 내용은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: be동사와 과거분사로 이루어진 수동태에서는 주어가 그 동작을 받는 대상입니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: When the intense heat damaged the crops, the farmers asked the government to inspect the soil.
syntax.promptKo: When으로 시작하는 절은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: when절은 주절의 일이 일어나는 때를 설명합니다.

readings.title: Before the Hill
readings.passageEn: A railway museum used an old carriage to transport visitors around its grounds. Before a school visit, a worker noticed a loose part beneath a seat. The route included a steep hill, so the team decided to inspect the whole carriage rather than repair only the visible problem. They found another loose connection near a wheel. The delayed departure disappointed some visitors, but the fuller inspection prevented a larger interruption later.

question.promptKo: 팀이 객차 전체를 점검한 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
choices: 보이는 문제 외에도 운행에 영향을 줄 문제가 있을 수 있어서
question.explanationKo: 가파른 언덕을 지나는 노선이므로 눈에 보이는 한 부분만 고치지 않고 객차 전체의 상태를 확인했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The route included a steep hill, so the team decided to inspect the whole carriage rather than repair only the visible problem.

readings.title: A Shared Table
readings.passageEn: To commemorate the opening of a community center, neighbors planned a small feast. At first, each family offered to bring its favorite dessert. The organizer realized that the table would have plenty of cake but almost no main dishes. She asked the group to designate one person to coordinate each part of the meal. Families still chose their own recipes, while the shared plan made the feast more balanced.

question.promptKo: 음식 준비 방식을 바꾼 뒤에도 가족들에게 남아 있던 선택은?
choices: 공동 계획 없이 모든 음식을 결정하는 것
각자 어떤 조리법을 사용할지 고르는 것
행사 장소를 각자 다른 곳으로 바꾸는 것
question.explanationKo: 식사의 각 부분을 조정하는 담당자는 정했지만 가족들은 여전히 자기 조리법을 선택할 수 있었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Families still chose their own recipes, while the shared plan made the feast more balanced.

syntax.sentenceEn: The executive wanted an immediate transition, while the researchers preferred to study its implications first.
syntax.promptKo: 이 문장에서 while은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 여기서 while은 서로 다른 두 상황을 나란히 놓아 대조합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: To protect vulnerable visitors, the museum designed an accessible alley with improved mobility in mind.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: An Unusual Drop
readings.passageEn: During an ongoing pond study, a class examined water through a microscope. One sample contained numerous tiny moving shapes, while another seemed empty. The students first thought the second pond had no small organisms. Their teacher asked them to examine several drops from different parts of the same sample. New shapes appeared. They recorded that a single drop could fail to represent the whole container, even when the equipment worked properly.

question.promptKo: 학생들이 여러 방울을 더 살펴본 뒤 알게 된 것은?
choices: 현미경은 언제나 실제로 없는 생물을 보여 준다는 것
두 번째 연못에는 작은 생물이 전혀 없다는 것
표본을 많이 보면 기록할 필요가 없다는 것
한 방울의 관찰만으로 전체 표본을 판단하기 어렵다는 것
question.explanationKo: 장비가 정상이어도 한 방울이 용기 전체의 상태를 대표하지 못할 수 있음을 확인했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: They recorded that a single drop could fail to represent the whole container, even when the equipment worked properly.

readings.title: The Missing Backdrop
readings.passageEn: A school play nearly fell into chaos when its painted backdrop failed to arrive. The drama club had to improvise with chairs and a plain sheet. Instead of hiding every transition between scenes, the actors moved the chairs where the audience could see them. Their clear movements showed when the story changed location. Afterward, several viewers said they had followed the plot easily, although the stage had looked very different from the original design.

question.promptKo: 관객이 장소 변화를 이해하도록 도운 것은?
choices: 관객에게 보이는 배우들의 분명한 의자 이동
모든 장면 사이를 완전히 가린 막
question.explanationKo: 배우들이 의자를 분명하게 옮기는 모습이 이야기의 장소가 바뀌는 시점을 알려 주었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Their clear movements showed when the story changed location.

syntax.sentenceEn: The shelter was inspected by a provincial official before the families were allowed to enter.
syntax.promptKo: 이 문장에서 수동태가 나타내는 내용은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: be동사와 과거분사로 이루어진 수동태에서는 주어가 그 동작을 받는 대상입니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The team will coordinate the preview so that every participant can negotiate a suitable role.
syntax.promptKo: so that 뒤의 절은 이 문장에서 무엇을 설명하나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 이 문장의 so that절은 앞의 행동으로 이루려는 목적을 설명합니다.

readings.title: Permission Before a Picture
readings.passageEn: An animal shelter invited students to help prepare adoption notices. Mina offered to coordinate the photographs, but one volunteer included people in the background of several pictures. The shelter asked for their consent before using those images. When two people preferred not to appear, Mina selected other photographs throughout the notice. The animals remained easy to see, and nobody had to accept unwanted publicity simply because they had come to help.

question.promptKo: 두 사람이 사진 공개를 원하지 않았을 때 미나가 한 일은?
choices: 동의를 받지 않고 같은 사진을 공개했다
공지 전체에서 다른 사진을 골라 사용했다
question.explanationKo: 두 사람이 사진에 나오기를 원하지 않자 미나는 그 사진 대신 다른 이미지를 선택했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: When two people preferred not to appear, Mina selected other photographs throughout the notice.

readings.title: A Quieter Advertisement
readings.passageEn: Before printing posters for a concert, a band gave nearby shopkeepers a preview. The bright design and short slogan were popular, but the plan to place a speaker outside every shop seemed a nuisance. The band offered to negotiate a quieter arrangement. The shops displayed the posters, and one indoor location played a short recording at agreed times. The advertisement still reached customers without turning the entire street into a loud performance.

question.promptKo: 밴드가 협의한 결과로 알맞은 것은?
choices: 가게에는 광고물을 전혀 두지 않기로 했다
포스터를 게시하고 정한 시간에 한 실내 장소에서 녹음을 틀었다
모든 가게 밖에서 계속 큰 소리로 공연했다
question.explanationKo: 가게의 불편을 줄이기 위해 포스터는 유지하고 녹음 재생 장소와 시간을 제한했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The shops displayed the posters, and one indoor location played a short recording at agreed times.

syntax.sentenceEn: When the enterprise began to prosper, its founder chose to admire the team's effort rather than claim all the credit.
syntax.promptKo: When으로 시작하는 절은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: when절은 주절의 일이 일어나는 때를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the correlation was strong, the researcher acknowledged a paradox in the overall pattern.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: Enough for the Last Tray
readings.passageEn: A baking club followed one recipe to make several successive trays of bread. The first group added extra flour whenever the dough felt sticky. By the third tray, their additions threatened to deplete the flour supply. Another student checked the recipe and measured the remaining ingredients. The club used the stated amounts for the final trays and wrote down which early changes had caused the shortage. They learned to examine repeated small decisions, not just the final missing bag.

question.promptKo: 밀가루가 부족해진 주된 이유는?
choices: 마지막 조가 정해진 양보다 밀가루를 덜 썼기 때문이다
처음부터 빵을 한 판만 만들 계획이었기 때문이다
조리법에 밀가루가 포함되어 있지 않았기 때문이다
처음 만든 반죽들에 밀가루를 조금씩 추가했기 때문이다
question.explanationKo: 첫 조가 반죽이 끈적할 때마다 밀가루를 더 넣은 행동이 여러 번 쌓여 재료 부족을 일으켰습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The first group added extra flour whenever the dough felt sticky.

readings.title: A Shop in the School Paper
readings.passageEn: For a newspaper profile, Joon interviewed the owner of a small bicycle-repair enterprise. Sales had risen during the same months that the town added cycle lanes. Joon wanted to say the lanes had caused the increase. The owner noted that she had also extended opening hours. Joon reported the correlation but did not claim to know its exact cause. His article distinguished an observed pattern from an explanation that required more evidence.

question.promptKo: 준이 기사에서 인과관계를 단정하지 않은 이유는?
choices: 영업시간 연장처럼 매출에 영향을 줄 다른 변화도 있었기 때문이다
자전거 가게가 실제로 존재하지 않았기 때문이다
매출이 늘었다는 사실을 누구도 확인하지 못했기 때문이다
자전거 도로와 매출 자료를 기사에서 모두 삭제했기 때문이다
question.explanationKo: 같은 시기에 영업시간도 늘었으므로 매출 증가를 자전거 도로 하나의 효과라고 단정할 수 없었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The owner noted that she had also extended opening hours.

syntax.sentenceEn: The crew did not cast a ballot until every member had explained a stance on the collaboration.
syntax.promptKo: not ... until 표현의 뜻으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
syntax.explanationKo: not ... until은 until 뒤의 시점이나 일이 되어야 비로소 주절의 일이 일어남을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: If we can afford the timber, we can build a stronger paddle before the next trip.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

readings.title: One Bench Together
readings.passageEn: Two school clubs wanted a bench for the garden, but neither could afford enough new timber alone. They decided to collaborate. The art club offered money and paint, while the science club supplied tools and measured the space. Sharing did not remove every difficulty: they still disagreed about the color. However, they settled that question after agreeing on the bench's size and purpose. A practical common goal helped them make progress before every preference matched.

question.promptKo: 두 동아리가 먼저 합의한 내용은?
question.explanationKo: 색깔 문제를 해결하기 전에 벤치의 크기와 목적에 먼저 합의했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: However, they settled that question after agreeing on the bench's size and purpose.

readings.title: A Clear Ballot
readings.passageEn: The atmosphere grew tense before a club voted on its next trip. Members could cast a ballot for either a museum or a forest walk. Several people misunderstood the form and marked both boxes. Rather than guess what those votes meant, the organizer explained the instructions and provided new blank forms to everyone. The second count took longer, but members accepted the result because the same clear rule applied to each ballot.

question.promptKo: 주최자가 모두에게 새 투표용지를 준 목적은?
choices: 첫 번째 투표 결과를 숨긴 채 확정하려고
같은 명확한 규칙에 따라 선택하게 하려고
question.explanationKo: 처음에는 표시 방법을 오해한 사람이 있었으므로 모두에게 같은 지침과 새 용지를 제공했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The second count took longer, but members accepted the result because the same clear rule applied to each ballot.

syntax.sentenceEn: The narrative was assembled from interviews and presented as a tribute to the local community.
syntax.promptKo: 이 문장에서 수동태가 나타내는 내용은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: be동사와 과거분사로 이루어진 수동태에서는 주어가 그 동작을 받는 대상입니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: To steer the project through unpredictable costs, the group agreed to rent rather than buy equipment.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: The Garden Box
readings.passageEn: Students wanted to assemble a compost box behind the school. They planned to shred fallen leaves before adding them, but their first design left no room to reach the material at the bottom. A gardener suggested a removable front panel. The group changed the drawing before cutting any wood. That small planning step saved them from building a box that was easy to fill but difficult to empty when the garden finally needed the compost.

question.promptKo: 앞면을 분리할 수 있게 설계를 바꾼 이유는?
choices: 나중에 안쪽의 퇴비를 꺼내기 쉽게 하려고
question.explanationKo: 원래 설계는 채우기는 쉬워도 비우기 어려웠으므로 앞판을 떼어 퇴비에 접근할 수 있게 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: That small planning step saved them from building a box that was easy to fill but difficult to empty when the garden finally needed the compost.

readings.title: A Tribute Indoors
readings.passageEn: The music club planned a tribute to its retiring teacher in an outdoor courtyard. Because the weather was unpredictable, members decided to rent a small hall instead. They shortened the program to cover the extra cost. Some students initially regretted losing two songs, but the teacher especially enjoyed the brief narrative that connected the remaining performances. A larger program was not necessary to explain what the teacher's work had meant to the club.

question.promptKo: 장소를 실내로 바꾼 직접적인 이유는?
choices: 남은 공연을 모두 취소하려 했기 때문이다
question.explanationKo: 야외 행사를 계획했지만 날씨가 불확실해 작은 실내 홀을 빌렸습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Because the weather was unpredictable, members decided to rent a small hall instead.

syntax.sentenceEn: One patrol follows the coastal trail, while another checks the inland domain.
syntax.promptKo: 이 문장에서 while은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 여기서 while은 서로 다른 두 상황을 나란히 놓아 대조합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Because the vegetarian meal was nutritious, the veteran recommended it to a fellow traveler.
syntax.promptKo: Because로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: because절은 뒤에 나오는 행동이나 상황의 이유를 설명합니다.

readings.title: Keeping the Trail Open
readings.passageEn: On a weekend patrol, park volunteers found branches that could obstruct a narrow trail. They moved the small pieces and marked a larger fallen trunk for the maintenance crew. One volunteer wanted to drag it away immediately, but doing so might damage the soft ground beside the path. The group reported its location and guided walkers along an existing alternative route. Keeping a route open did not require solving every problem with the tools they carried.

question.promptKo: 봉사자들이 큰 나무를 바로 옮기지 않은 이유는?
choices: 대체 경로가 있다는 사실을 몰랐기 때문이다
옆의 무른 땅을 손상시킬 수 있었기 때문이다
산책객에게 길을 알려 주기 싫었기 때문이다
가지가 길을 막지 않는다는 결론을 내렸기 때문이다
question.explanationKo: 큰 나무를 끌어내면 주변 땅을 손상시킬 수 있어 위치를 보고하고 기존의 다른 길로 안내했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: One volunteer wanted to drag it away immediately, but doing so might damage the soft ground beside the path.

readings.title: More Than One Menu
readings.passageEn: A student interviewer expected a vegetarian chef to cook only salads. The chef gave her a gracious welcome and showed her a menu of soups, baked dishes, and warm grain bowls. Cooking had become his vocation because he enjoyed combining familiar ingredients in unexpected ways. The interview changed the student's narrow stereotype. In her article, she described what the chef actually made instead of presenting her first assumption as a fact about every vegetarian cook.

question.promptKo: 인터뷰가 학생의 생각에 준 변화는?
choices: 요리사를 만나기 전 가정을 그대로 사실로 쓰게 했다
모든 요리사가 똑같은 메뉴를 만든다고 믿게 했다
채식 요리사의 음식이 다양할 수 있음을 알게 했다
채식 요리는 반드시 샐러드뿐이라고 확신하게 했다
question.explanationKo: 여러 종류의 음식을 직접 보고 처음의 좁은 고정관념을 바꾸었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The interview changed the student's narrow stereotype.

syntax.sentenceEn: When the crisis began to recur, the team tried to locate its structural cause.
syntax.promptKo: When으로 시작하는 절은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: when절은 주절의 일이 일어나는 때를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The applicant who could mimic the model's motion helped us examine its elastic structure.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: Light Inside the Model
readings.passageEn: A design class built a hollow model of a public hall. To illuminate the rooms, students placed small battery lights inside. They then noticed that one thin wall bent whenever they lifted the model. The problem was structural rather than electrical. Adding brighter lights would not help. They reinforced the weak wall and tested the model again before decorating it, learning to identify which part of a design actually needed attention.

question.promptKo: 학생들이 해결해야 했던 문제는?
question.explanationKo: 모형을 들 때 얇은 벽이 휘었으므로 조명이 아니라 구조를 보강해야 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The problem was structural rather than electrical.

readings.title: Two Ways to Organize
readings.passageEn: Each applicant for a student exchange had to organize a short group activity. Hana prepared a detailed timetable, while her counterpart at the partner school preferred to leave space for discussion. Neither student could disprove the value of the other's method before trying it. They combined a fixed opening activity with a flexible final discussion. The trial showed that their different approaches could solve different parts of the same planning problem.

question.promptKo: 두 학생이 최종적으로 선택한 방식은?
choices: 처음 활동은 고정하고 마지막 토의는 유연하게 진행하는 방식
두 사람의 계획을 모두 버리고 활동을 없애는 방식
모든 토의를 금지하고 시간표만 읽는 방식
처음부터 끝까지 아무 순서도 정하지 않는 방식
question.explanationKo: 한 방법만 옳다고 단정하지 않고 정해진 시작 활동과 유연한 마무리 토의를 결합했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: They combined a fixed opening activity with a flexible final discussion.

syntax.sentenceEn: We will examine the precaution carefully so that no hidden pest can enter the protected garden.
syntax.promptKo: so that 뒤의 절은 이 문장에서 무엇을 설명하나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 이 문장의 so that절은 앞의 행동으로 이루려는 목적을 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the religious groups disagreed, they found a compromise based on mutual obligation.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: A Fair Equipment Schedule
readings.passageEn: Two teams argued over the only indoor practice area. Their disagreement lowered morale and made joint events awkward. A teacher asked them to examine when they actually needed the space. One team practiced skills that required a smooth floor, while the other mainly needed shelter from rain. They reached a compromise: the first team received regular indoor sessions, and the second could move indoors during bad weather. The schedule reflected needs rather than equal hours alone.

question.promptKo: 실내 사용 시간을 정할 때 고려한 것은?
choices: 두 팀이 실내 공간을 필요로 하는 서로 다른 이유
두 팀의 이름을 알파벳순으로 놓은 결과
question.explanationKo: 두 팀의 실제 활동 조건을 살펴보고 필요에 맞게 공간을 나누었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The schedule reflected needs rather than equal hours alone.

readings.title: Looking After the Seedlings
readings.passageEn: A garden coordinator planned to entrust a tray of seedlings to each class. As a precaution, she asked students to label the trays before moving them. Meanwhile, an older student showed how similar two plant varieties looked at this early stage. The labels seemed unnecessary on the first morning, when everyone remembered the plants. A week later, however, they allowed another class to continue the work without guessing which seedlings needed which care.

question.promptKo: 처음 붙인 이름표가 일주일 뒤 유용했던 이유는?
choices: 학생들이 식물을 모두 버리기로 했기 때문이다
이름표가 식물에 물을 자동으로 주었기 때문이다
다른 반이 식물 종류를 추측하지 않고 일을 이어갈 수 있었기 때문이다
모든 묘목이 같은 식물로 바뀌었기 때문이다
question.explanationKo: 처음 담당했던 학생이 아니어도 이름표를 보고 식물을 구별하여 작업을 이어갈 수 있었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: A week later, however, they allowed another class to continue the work without guessing which seedlings needed which care.

syntax.sentenceEn: The marine exhibit was amended after a preliminary review revealed a problem with the labels.
syntax.promptKo: 이 문장에서 수동태가 나타내는 내용은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: be동사와 과거분사로 이루어진 수동태에서는 주어가 그 동작을 받는 대상입니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: To reduce friction, the team agreed to preserve each member's autonomy during the project.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: A Story with Several Voices
readings.passageEn: Students collected local folklore for a school exhibition. In their preliminary interviews, two grandparents told different versions of the same story. The students first planned to choose the version they heard earlier. Instead, they decided to amend the display so that both versions appeared with the speakers' explanations. The differences showed how a shared story could change as families retold it. Preserving those differences made the exhibition more informative than forcing one account to represent everyone.

question.promptKo: 학생들이 전시 내용을 수정한 방법은?
choices: 서로 다른 부분을 출처 없이 하나로 합쳤다
두 가지 이야기를 설명과 함께 모두 실었다
question.explanationKo: 어느 한 이야기를 모두의 이야기로 정하지 않고 서로 다른 두 버전을 함께 보여 주었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Instead, they decided to amend the display so that both versions appeared with the speakers' explanations.

readings.title: A Small Repair
readings.passageEn: A rowing club found a worn patch on the sleeve of an old uniform. Members wanted a new outfit for every rower before a regional event, but the cost would become a burden on several families. They repaired usable uniforms and replaced only the damaged items. The team still looked organized at the event. More importantly, no student had to miss the trip because the club had treated a complete set of new clothing as essential.

question.promptKo: 조정 동아리가 낡은 제복을 일부 수선한 목적은?
choices: 모든 가족에게 새 옷 비용을 부담시키지 않으려고
학생마다 서로 다른 팀에 들어가게 하려고
question.explanationKo: 새 제복을 전원에게 마련하면 일부 가족에게 부담이 되므로 쓸 수 있는 옷은 수선했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Members wanted a new outfit for every rower before a regional event, but the cost would become a burden on several families.

syntax.sentenceEn: The inspector did not dismiss the charge until a careful review exposed the fraud.
syntax.promptKo: not ... until 표현의 뜻으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
syntax.explanationKo: not ... until은 until 뒤의 시점이나 일이 되어야 비로소 주절의 일이 일어남을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The medieval outline which inspired the artist became the basis for a modern analogy.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: A Model That Could Break
readings.passageEn: For a medieval history fair, a class built a model castle from thin clay. Its towers looked convincing, but one fell when a spectator leaned on the table. Before making rapid repairs, the builders drew an outline showing where stronger supports were needed. They wanted the model to survive ordinary visits, not merely look impressive in a photograph. A low barrier later kept visitors close enough to see the details without touching the fragile walls.

question.promptKo: 학생들이 수리 전에 도면을 그린 이유는?
choices: 더 튼튼한 지지대가 필요한 곳을 찾으려고
방문객이 성을 전혀 보지 못하게 하려고
question.explanationKo: 성 모형이 실제 관람 중에도 견디도록 보강할 위치를 먼저 계획했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Before making rapid repairs, the builders drew an outline showing where stronger supports were needed.

readings.title: Evidence Before an Accusation
readings.passageEn: A school shop received a complaint about a charge that appeared twice on a receipt. One student immediately called it fraud. The shop manager asked everyone to avoid a premature conclusion while she checked the records. The payment system had printed the same line twice, but the bank record showed only one payment. The manager corrected the receipt and explained the difference between a printing mistake and evidence of someone deliberately taking extra money.

question.promptKo: 은행 기록을 확인하여 밝혀진 사실은?
choices: 가게가 일부러 두 번 돈을 받았다
question.explanationKo: 영수증의 중복 표시는 있었지만 은행 기록상 결제는 한 번이어서 고의적인 이중 청구라는 주장은 뒷받침되지 않았습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The payment system had printed the same line twice, but the bank record showed only one payment.

syntax.sentenceEn: The sturdy shelter could endure the storm, while the fragile fence collapsed.
syntax.promptKo: 이 문장에서 while은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 여기서 while은 서로 다른 두 상황을 나란히 놓아 대조합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: If the paths are parallel, each visitor can take an equivalent route through the meadow.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

readings.title: A Bridge for the Meadow
readings.passageEn: A walking club needed a small bridge across a wet part of a meadow. Its first design looked sturdy, yet the builder wanted an explicit limit on how many people could cross together. Members tested the bridge with carefully measured loads before opening it. They also recorded the duration of each test. The result was a sign explaining safe use, rather than a vague promise that a strong-looking bridge could endure any weight.

question.promptKo: 다리가 튼튼해 보여도 시험을 실시한 이유는?
choices: 안전하게 사용할 수 있는 구체적인 한계를 정하려고
question.explanationKo: 겉모습만으로 무게를 견딘다고 단정하지 않고 실제 시험으로 안전한 사용 기준을 정했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The result was a sign explaining safe use, rather than a vague promise that a strong-looking bridge could endure any weight.

readings.title: One Budget, Two Priorities
readings.passageEn: A student magazine wanted to try a new venture: a special issue about neighborhood gardens. A frugal editor suggested printing fewer copies, while another worried that some readers would miss it. They agreed to give every classroom an equivalent number of copies and publish the full issue online as well. This parallel arrangement did not require every reader to own a printed copy. It kept the small printing budget from deciding who could read the magazine.

question.promptKo: 학생 잡지가 인쇄본과 온라인판을 함께 만든 목적은?
choices: 인쇄 예산이 적어도 모두 읽을 수 있게 하려고
question.explanationKo: 교실별 인쇄본과 온라인판을 병행하여 적은 인쇄 예산이 독자의 접근을 제한하지 않도록 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: It kept the small printing budget from deciding who could read the magazine.

syntax.sentenceEn: When the textile was examined under a bright light, its clumsy repairs became obvious.
syntax.promptKo: When으로 시작하는 절은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: when절은 주절의 일이 일어나는 때를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: To describe the subsequent event, the historian used an approximate date and a statistical estimate.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: What the Fabric Suggested
readings.passageEn: A museum volunteer examined a textile found in an old house. Its bright colors made her imagine that it had belonged to an aristocrat. The curator asked her to describe the material before proposing an owner. A subsequent search found similar cloth in ordinary workers' clothing from the same period. The display therefore gave an approximate date and described the weaving method, while leaving the original owner's identity open. Attractive colors alone could not establish social rank.

question.promptKo: 전시에서 천의 원래 주인을 확정하지 않은 이유는?
choices: 모든 옛 옷이 귀족 소유로 밝혀져서
색깔만으로 주인의 사회적 지위를 판단할 수 없어서
question.explanationKo: 같은 시대 노동자 옷에서도 비슷한 천이 발견되었으므로 화려한 색만으로 귀족 소유라고 결론 낼 수 없습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Attractive colors alone could not establish social rank.

readings.title: A Fair Comparison of Routes
readings.passageEn: A hiking group compared two routes across uneven terrain. One route seemed cleaner because volunteers had collected its rubbish the previous morning. To make a useful statistical comparison, the group counted litter on both routes after the same number of days without a cleanup. They also recorded visitor numbers. The second survey did not simply repeat their first impression. It showed why observations need comparable conditions before they can support a claim about which trail visitors keep cleaner.

question.promptKo: 두 번째 조사에서 청소 후 경과 일수를 같게 맞춘 이유는?
question.explanationKo: 직전에 청소한 길이 유리해지는 영향을 줄이려고 같은 기간 동안 쌓인 쓰레기를 비교했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: To make a useful statistical comparison, the group counted litter on both routes after the same number of days without a cleanup.

syntax.sentenceEn: The apparatus was inspected at the border before its owner received a final verdict.
syntax.promptKo: 이 문장에서 수동태가 나타내는 내용은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: be동사와 과거분사로 이루어진 수동태에서는 주어가 그 동작을 받는 대상입니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the gust was strong, the collective effort kept the stall from falling over.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: A Shorter Weather Notice
readings.passageEn: After a sudden gust damaged several stalls, a market needed a clear weather notice. The first draft included countless details about earlier storms. An editor suggested that the writers condense it and keep only information relevant to tomorrow's visitors. The final notice identified the covered area, the closing time, and where updates would appear. Historical facts were moved to a separate page. The change helped readers act quickly without suggesting that the longer history was unimportant.

question.promptKo: 날씨 안내문을 줄일 때 적용한 기준은?
choices: 과거 폭풍 이야기를 모두 첫 문장에 넣었다
다음 날 방문객의 행동에 필요한 정보를 남겼다
question.explanationKo: 안내문은 방문객에게 당장 필요한 위치·시간·업데이트 정보를 중심으로 정리되었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: An editor suggested that the writers condense it and keep only information relevant to tomorrow's visitors.

readings.title: Testing the Shared Camera
readings.passageEn: A science club bought a small camera for collective use. Its cable fit an old computer, so members assumed the two devices were compatible. However, the camera needed software the computer could not run. Rather than widen the scope of their project by buying another computer, they borrowed a newer one for the first test. The experience taught them to check the whole apparatus, including software, before treating a matching cable as proof that equipment would work together.

question.promptKo: 카메라 케이블이 맞는데도 작동하지 않은 이유는?
choices: 컴퓨터가 필요한 소프트웨어를 실행할 수 없어서
question.explanationKo: 물리적인 케이블 연결뿐 아니라 소프트웨어 요구 조건도 호환되어야 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: However, the camera needed software the computer could not run.

syntax.sentenceEn: The team replaced the outdated guide so that accurate information could counteract the misleading discourse.
syntax.promptKo: so that 뒤의 절은 이 문장에서 무엇을 설명하나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 이 문장의 so that절은 앞의 행동으로 이루려는 목적을 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: If you sustain an uncomfortable posture, the resulting distress may interrupt your work.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

readings.title: An Archive People Could Use
readings.passageEn: A local history group considered replacing an outdated website with a colorful video page. One member had firsthand experience helping older residents search the archive. She said that readable labels and a simple search box were indispensable, whereas large moving images sometimes made navigation difficult. The group kept those basic tools and added optional videos beside written descriptions. The redesign focused on helping people find records, instead of assuming that newer visual effects automatically made the archive easier to use.

question.promptKo: 역사 모임이 새 웹사이트에도 유지한 것은?
choices: 설명 없이 움직이는 그림만 있는 첫 화면
question.explanationKo: 자료를 실제로 찾는 사람에게 필요한 읽기 쉬운 표시와 검색 기능을 유지하고 영상은 선택적으로 보도록 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: She said that readable labels and a simple search box were indispensable, whereas large moving images sometimes made navigation difficult.

readings.title: Work That Could Continue
readings.passageEn: At a plant nursery, volunteers tried to sustain a weekly watering schedule. One person was attempting to juggle nearly every task and often stayed late. The coordinator faced a dilemma: praising that effort might encourage a routine that depended on someone becoming exhausted. She divided the work into shorter shifts and trained two people for each job. The new plan made room for absences and allowed the garden to keep running without relying on a single volunteer's constant availability.

question.promptKo: 새 작업 계획이 해결하려 한 문제는?
choices: 모든 자원봉사자가 같은 시간에 쉬는 문제
정원에서 일을 나눌 수 없는 문제
한 사람의 지속적인 참여에 일이 지나치게 의존하는 문제
식물이 물을 전혀 필요로 하지 않는 문제
question.explanationKo: 짧은 교대와 역할별 대체 인력을 마련해 한 사람이 빠져도 정원 관리가 이어지게 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The new plan made room for absences and allowed the garden to keep running without relying on a single volunteer's constant availability.

syntax.sentenceEn: The janitor did not intervene until the visitors began to encircle the fragile display.
syntax.promptKo: not ... until 표현의 뜻으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
syntax.explanationKo: not ... until은 until 뒤의 시점이나 일이 되어야 비로소 주절의 일이 일어남을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: To clarify the notion, the advocate chose a familiar example from local cuisine.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: The Empty Space on the Display
readings.passageEn: A student found a fragment of a painted bowl and wanted to draw the missing pattern. The teacher helping oversee the exhibition asked her to clarify which lines were visible and which were imagined. The student made two images: a photograph of the fragment and a possible reconstruction. Visitors could compare them without confusing the student's idea with the surviving object. Leaving uncertainty visible made the display more honest, even though a complete pattern might have looked more impressive.

question.promptKo: 학생이 사진과 복원 예상도를 구분해 전시한 이유는?
choices: 관람객이 두 그림을 비교하지 못하게 하려고
실제로 남은 부분과 추측한 부분을 구별하려고
question.explanationKo: 실물 사진과 가능한 복원안을 나란히 두면 관람객이 관찰한 사실과 추측을 혼동하지 않습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Visitors could compare them without confusing the student's idea with the surviving object.

readings.title: A Menu with Explanations
readings.passageEn: For an international lunch, students wanted to introduce unfamiliar cuisine through a tasting table. A visitor offered to oversee preparation, but the school janitor noticed that the proposed tables would block the corridor. The organizers moved the event into the dining room and added ingredient labels. Their aim was to cultivate curiosity without making guests guess what they were eating or walk through a crowded exit. The revised arrangement connected cultural interest with practical care for the people attending.

question.promptKo: 행사 주최 측이 계획을 수정한 방식으로 옳은 것은?
choices: 식당으로 장소를 옮기고 재료 표시를 추가했다
복도 출구 앞에 식탁을 더 놓았다
question.explanationKo: 통로를 막는 배치를 고치고 음식의 재료도 안내하여 참석자가 편리하게 참여하도록 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The organizers moved the event into the dining room and added ingredient labels.

syntax.sentenceEn: The committee wanted to declare a unanimous decision, while one member still questioned the scheme.
syntax.promptKo: 이 문장에서 while은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 여기서 while은 서로 다른 두 상황을 나란히 놓아 대조합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Because the constraint limited our time, we had to discern the most useful evidence quickly.
syntax.promptKo: Because로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: because절은 뒤에 나오는 행동이나 상황의 이유를 설명합니다.

readings.title: A Decision after the Questions
readings.passageEn: A student council prepared to appoint a festival coordinator. One candidate gave a brisk speech and received immediate applause. Before anyone could declare a unanimous choice, a member asked each candidate the same questions about time, cost, and available helpers. The discussion revealed a major constraint in the popular candidate's schedule. The council postponed its decision until all candidates had explained workable plans. Applause had shown enthusiasm, but it had not answered the practical questions involved in organizing the event.

question.promptKo: 학생회가 결정을 미룬 이유는?
choices: 후보들의 실행 가능한 계획을 더 확인해야 해서
question.explanationKo: 인기 있는 연설만으로는 일정과 인력 등의 현실적인 조건을 확인할 수 없어 계획을 더 듣기로 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The council postponed its decision until all candidates had explained workable plans.

readings.title: What Happened beneath the Water
readings.passageEn: During an experiment, students watched sugar dissolve in a clear jar. A worksheet asked them to weigh the closed jar before and after mixing. Some could no longer discern any grains and predicted that the jar would become lighter. The measurements did not support that prediction. To examine the mistaken assumption, the teacher placed another sealed sample underneath a bright lamp so students could observe it more carefully. Losing sight of a substance was not the same as showing that it had left the container.

question.promptKo: 설탕이 보이지 않게 된 뒤 무게 측정이 보여 준 것은?
choices: 밝은 램프가 병 속 설탕을 만들어 낸다
눈으로 볼 수 있는 물질만 무게를 가진다
보이지 않는다고 물질이 용기 밖으로 사라진 것은 아니다
설탕이 녹으면 닫힌 병의 무게가 반드시 줄어든다
question.explanationKo: 밀폐된 병의 전후 무게를 비교한 결과는 설탕 알갱이가 안 보여도 물질이 밖으로 사라졌다는 뜻은 아님을 보여 주었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Losing sight of a substance was not the same as showing that it had left the container.

syntax.sentenceEn: The rectangular headquarters was renovated after the delegates approved the proposed budget.
syntax.promptKo: 이 문장에서 수동태가 나타내는 내용은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: be동사와 과거분사로 이루어진 수동태에서는 주어가 그 동작을 받는 대상입니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: If the pilot is punctual, the passengers can leave at the planned interval without another delay.
syntax.promptKo: If로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: if절은 뒤의 일이 성립하는 조건을 제시합니다.

readings.title: Preparing the Workshop
readings.passageEn: A club wanted to renovate a small workshop before its open day. The elected organizer began to delegate jobs, but she did not assume that every volunteer shared the same expertise. An experienced member checked the tools, while beginners cleaned benches and labeled drawers. Work paused at a regular interval so the group could review progress. By matching jobs to experience and checking them together, the club finished the preparation without treating speed as more important than careful work.

question.promptKo: 조직자가 작업을 나눈 기준은?
choices: 모든 사람이 같은 기술을 지녔다는 가정
question.explanationKo: 도구 확인은 경험 있는 구성원이, 정리와 이름표 붙이기는 초보자가 맡아 능력에 맞게 역할을 나누었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: An experienced member checked the tools, while beginners cleaned benches and labeled drawers.

readings.title: A Schedule That Respected Travel
readings.passageEn: A debate team praised members who were punctual, but one student often arrived shortly after practice began. Before giving a sharp retort, the captain tried to empathize with him and asked about his journey. His bus reached the school only after the scheduled starting time. The team moved its warm-up ten minutes later. The captain realized that calling the student careless had been arbitrary when no one had checked whether the timetable allowed him to arrive on time.

question.promptKo: 주장이 처음 판단을 바꾼 계기는?
choices: 버스 도착 시간상 기존 연습 시작에 맞출 수 없음을 알게 된 것
학생이 연습 자체를 싫어한다고 말한 것
토론팀이 버스 노선을 직접 바꾼 것
다른 모든 학생도 지각하기 시작한 것
question.explanationKo: 학생의 이동 조건을 확인하자 지각이 부주의 때문이라는 처음 판단에 근거가 부족했음을 알게 되었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: His bus reached the school only after the scheduled starting time.

syntax.sentenceEn: When the manuscript was verified, the editor found a drawback in the proposed arrangement.
syntax.promptKo: When으로 시작하는 절은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: when절은 주절의 일이 일어나는 때를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the estate was large, its owners wanted wildlife and visitors to coexist peacefully.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: Checking the Missing Page
readings.passageEn: Two editors had a dispute about a missing page in a manuscript. One believed the writer had removed it; the other thought it had fallen from a stack of papers. Before asking the writer to explain, they decided to verify the page numbers against a scanned copy. The digital version contained the page, and they soon found the paper beneath a folder. Checking the available record resolved the disagreement more quickly than arguing about what someone else might have intended.

question.promptKo: 편집자들이 먼저 확인한 것은?
question.explanationKo: 작가의 의도를 추측하기 전에 스캔 자료와 실제 원고의 페이지를 대조했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Before asking the writer to explain, they decided to verify the page numbers against a scanned copy.

readings.title: Two Uses for One Garden
readings.passageEn: A community garden offered a quiet reading corner and a busy children's planting area. Some members believed the two uses could not coexist. Their main concern was that new tables would displace the flower beds. A designer proposed a small shared seating area outside both sections. Its drawback was limited seating, but it preserved the beds and kept the reading corner quieter. Members tried the arrangement for a month before deciding whether a larger change was necessary.

question.promptKo: 공유 좌석을 작게 설치한 방안의 단점은?
choices: 아이들이 식물을 기를 수 없다는 점
앉을 수 있는 자리가 제한적이라는 점
question.explanationKo: 작은 공유 공간은 좌석 수가 적다는 단점이 있지만 꽃밭과 조용한 독서 공간을 지킬 수 있었습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Its drawback was limited seating, but it preserved the beds and kept the reading corner quieter.

syntax.sentenceEn: The workers will move the temporary kitchen so that hazardous fumes cannot reach the food.
syntax.promptKo: so that 뒤의 절은 이 문장에서 무엇을 설명하나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 이 문장의 so that절은 앞의 행동으로 이루려는 목적을 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The prehistoric skull which occupies the display helps us compare the dimensions of two species.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: A Safer Route through the Shed
readings.passageEn: While preparing a garden shed, volunteers found a barrel blocking the marked path to the door. A shelf nearby held detergent and other supplies. Rather than make a rash attempt to move everything at once, the coordinator stopped work and asked the caretaker to identify the containers. Unknown contents could be hazardous, and clearing a path should not create a new danger. After the caretaker checked the materials, the group moved the safe items and reopened the route.

question.promptKo: 관리자가 작업을 잠시 중단시킨 이유는?
choices: 정체를 모르는 내용물을 먼저 확인해야 해서
question.explanationKo: 통로를 치우는 중에도 새 위험을 만들지 않도록 용기 안의 물질을 먼저 확인했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Unknown contents could be hazardous, and clearing a path should not create a new danger.

readings.title: Continuing a Useful Tradition
readings.passageEn: A new school newspaper editor admired her predecessor's clear writing but wanted to change every section at once. A teacher suggested that she examine the old paper before she tried to proclaim a new direction. The editor found a short advice column that had become a staple for younger readers. Removing it might alienate the students she hoped to reach. She kept that column, invited new questions, and changed the layout around it, combining continuity with a fresh design.

question.promptKo: 새 편집자가 기존 상담 칼럼을 유지한 이유는?
choices: 어린 독자에게 이미 중요한 코너였기 때문이다
이전 편집자의 모든 구성을 그대로 복사하려고
question.explanationKo: 이전 신문의 유용한 기능을 확인한 뒤 독자에게 익숙하고 필요한 상담 칼럼은 남겼습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The editor found a short advice column that had become a staple for younger readers.

syntax.sentenceEn: The eligible manuscript was summarized by the editor before the final selection meeting.
syntax.promptKo: 이 문장에서 수동태가 나타내는 내용은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: be동사와 과거분사로 이루어진 수동태에서는 주어가 그 동작을 받는 대상입니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: To prevent burnout, the group chose simplicity over a perpetual overload of small tasks.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: A Reminder with Tact
readings.passageEn: A club leader wanted to summarize unfinished work before a public event. Her first message listed every mistake beside the responsible person's name. Another member suggested using more tact: identify the remaining tasks and invite people to ask for help. The simpler message did not hide legitimate concerns about missed deadlines. It made those concerns easier to discuss without adding embarrassment to an existing overload of work. Members then offered to share tasks instead of spending the meeting defending themselves.

question.promptKo: 수정된 안내문의 효과는?
choices: 모든 작업을 행사 뒤로 미루게 했다
남은 일을 나누어 맡는 논의를 쉽게 했다
누가 더 잘못했는지 공개적으로 경쟁하게 했다
question.explanationKo: 남은 과제와 도움 요청에 초점을 맞춘 안내 덕분에 구성원들이 변명보다 작업 분담에 집중했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Members then offered to share tasks instead of spending the meeting defending themselves.

readings.title: A Problem in the Timetable
readings.passageEn: A school offered a workshop to every student eligible for the program. Registration looked simple, but the timetable placed two popular sessions at the same time. The organizer proposed a plausible solution: shuffle the second session to a later period. Before announcing the change, she checked room availability and asked the instructor. Both were free at the new time. The revised timetable let students attend both sessions without pretending that a scheduling conflict was a lack of interest.

question.promptKo: 두 인기 강좌의 시간을 다르게 바꾼 이유는?
choices: 학생들이 강좌에 관심이 없다고 보여 주려고
학생들이 두 강좌에 모두 참여할 수 있도록
신청 자격이 있는 학생 수를 줄이려고
question.explanationKo: 신청 충돌의 원인이 관심 부족이 아니라 같은 시간대 편성이었으므로 시간을 조정했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The revised timetable let students attend both sessions without pretending that a scheduling conflict was a lack of interest.

syntax.sentenceEn: The company did not merge the departments until everyone understood what the change would entail.
syntax.promptKo: not ... until 표현의 뜻으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
syntax.explanationKo: not ... until은 until 뒤의 시점이나 일이 되어야 비로소 주절의 일이 일어남을 나타냅니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the crew felt frantic, their conviction helped them tackle one problem at a time.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: A Store with a Clearer System
readings.passageEn: Two student groups decided to merge their stalls at a school fair. One sold notebooks and the other sold badges; their price signs were blue and green, respectively. When a crowd arrived, helpers became frantic because the mixed merchandise made each order difficult to track. They kept one shared payment point but separated the display areas and labeled them clearly. Working together did not require putting every object in one pile. The new arrangement combined shared effort with a system visitors could understand.

question.promptKo: 두 모둠이 협업하면서 바꾼 방식은?
choices: 모든 상품을 표시 없이 한데 쌓았다
결제는 함께 하고 상품 진열은 구분했다
question.explanationKo: 공동 결제의 장점은 유지하되 상품 구역을 나누어 주문과 선택이 명확해지도록 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: They kept one shared payment point but separated the display areas and labeled them clearly.

readings.title: Before Removing the Old Wall
readings.passageEn: A neighborhood group wanted to tackle the problem of a narrow entrance to its shared garden. The quickest plan was to demolish an old wall. However, the work would entail closing the only path used by nearby residents for several days. A member suggested widening just one section first. The group compared both plans before deciding. Their strong conviction that the entrance needed improvement did not remove the need to consider how the repair would affect people outside the garden group.

question.promptKo: 전체 벽 철거 계획을 바로 실행하지 않은 이유는?
choices: 주민들이 쓰는 유일한 길이 며칠간 막힐 수 있어서
question.explanationKo: 정원 이용자에게 좋은 개선이라도 이웃의 통행에 미칠 영향을 함께 고려해야 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: However, the work would entail closing the only path used by nearby residents for several days.

syntax.sentenceEn: One model describes refraction, while the other explains the erosion of the shore.
syntax.promptKo: 이 문장에서 while은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 여기서 while은 서로 다른 두 상황을 나란히 놓아 대조합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: To avoid an unsupported inference, the researcher compared multiple accounts before drawing a conclusion.
syntax.promptKo: 문장 앞의 To + 동사원형은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 문장 앞의 to부정사구는 뒤에 나오는 행동을 하는 목적을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: A Science Display at Dusk
readings.passageEn: For an evening science event, students planned a refraction display using a clear container of water and a striped card. At dusk, the stripes became difficult to see. They first made the inference that something had changed in the water. A classmate suggested checking the light before replacing any materials. Under a nearby lamp, the stripes were clear again. Trying multiple explanations helped the team identify poor visibility as the problem, rather than changing a demonstration that still worked.

question.promptKo: 줄무늬가 잘 보이지 않은 직접적인 원인으로 확인된 것은?
question.explanationKo: 램프 아래에서 다시 잘 보였으므로 재료의 변화보다 조명 부족이 문제였음을 확인할 수 있습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Under a nearby lamp, the stripes were clear again.

readings.title: A Story from Different Experiences
readings.passageEn: A drama club created a play set in a cosmopolitan train station. One writer relied on a secondhand account of a passenger's argument and made that passenger the antagonist. Another member suggested hearing more than one perspective before fixing the character's motives. The revised scene included a missed announcement and a misplaced bag. The disagreement remained, but it no longer depended on assuming that a stranger had acted badly without reason. A fuller situation produced a more believable story.

question.promptKo: 수정된 장면이 더 설득력 있게 된 이유는?
choices: 한 사람의 전해 들은 말만 더 강조했기 때문이다
배경을 기차역이 아닌 학교로 바꾸었기 때문이다
갈등에 영향을 준 추가 상황을 포함했기 때문이다
승객 간 의견 차이를 모두 삭제했기 때문이다
question.explanationKo: 안내 방송을 놓치고 가방을 잘못 둔 상황을 더하여 한 인물을 이유 없이 나쁜 사람으로 단정하지 않게 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: The revised scene included a missed announcement and a misplaced bag.

syntax.sentenceEn: When scrutiny of the synthetic surface uncovered signs of wear, the engineer ordered a more thorough inspection.
syntax.promptKo: When으로 시작하는 절은 무엇을 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: when절은 주절의 일이 일어나는 때를 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: The productive discussion which exposed the pitfall helped us avoid a reckless decision.
syntax.promptKo: who 또는 which로 시작하는 절의 역할은 무엇인가요?
syntax.explanationKo: 관계절은 앞에 나온 사람이나 사물에 관한 정보를 덧붙입니다.

readings.title: More Useful Than a Bigger Bin
readings.passageEn: A school wanted a productive way to reduce the waste sent to a landfill. At the outset, students proposed buying larger bins. Closer scrutiny showed that many discarded notebooks still contained unused pages. The school set up a collection box for these pages and bound them into practice pads. Larger bins might have made waste easier to store, but reusing suitable paper reduced the amount thrown away. The group measured the collected pages rather than judging success by the size of its new equipment.

question.promptKo: 학생들이 큰 쓰레기통 구매보다 종이 재사용에 집중한 이유는?
choices: 재사용한 종이의 양을 기록할 수 없어서
버리는 양 자체를 줄일 수 있어서
question.explanationKo: 큰 통은 보관을 돕지만 사용하지 않은 종이를 다시 쓰면 실제 폐기량을 줄일 수 있습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Larger bins might have made waste easier to store, but reusing suitable paper reduced the amount thrown away.

readings.title: A Boundary Visitors Could See
readings.passageEn: A nature center placed a hybrid visitor shelter near a wetland, using both reused wood and new materials. Staff marked a small radius around it where construction had disturbed the ground. A guide warned that visitors could easily intrude on the recovering area because the boundary was hard to see. Rather than call people reckless after they crossed it, the center added a low rope and clear signs. Making the limit visible helped visitors protect a place they had come to enjoy.

question.promptKo: 자연 센터가 낮은 줄과 안내판을 추가한 목적은?
choices: 방문객이 회복 중인 구역의 경계를 알아보게 하려고
question.explanationKo: 눈에 잘 띄지 않던 경계를 표시하여 방문객이 보호 구역을 모르고 침범하는 일을 줄이려 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Making the limit visible helped visitors protect a place they had come to enjoy.

syntax.sentenceEn: The town will improve its infrastructure so that a temporary setback does not prevent future growth.
syntax.promptKo: so that 뒤의 절은 이 문장에서 무엇을 설명하나요?
syntax.explanationKo: 이 문장의 so that절은 앞의 행동으로 이루려는 목적을 설명합니다.

syntax.sentenceEn: Although the fluctuation was small, a prudent observer considered its cumulative effect.
syntax.promptKo: Although로 시작하는 절은 어떤 관계를 나타내나요?
syntax.explanationKo: although는 앞의 상황에도 불구하고 뒤의 일이 성립함을 나타냅니다.

readings.title: One Setback in a Longer Project
readings.passageEn: A community garden's first planting phase suffered a setback when heavy rain damaged several beds. The team still had enthusiasm, but its leader proposed a prudent pause before buying more plants. Members checked drainage and repaired the paths first. They then planted a smaller area and recorded the results. The delay was not an abandonment of the project. It allowed the next step to respond to what the first attempt had revealed, instead of repeating the same problem on a larger scale.

question.promptKo: 팀이 새 식물을 사기 전에 잠시 멈춘 이유는?
choices: 첫 시도에서 드러난 배수 문제를 먼저 개선하려고
식물을 더 큰 구역에 즉시 심으려고
question.explanationKo: 비 피해 뒤 곧바로 규모를 늘리지 않고 배수와 통로를 점검해 같은 문제가 반복되지 않게 했습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Members checked drainage and repaired the paths first.

readings.title: Watching the Change Over Time
readings.passageEn: A student observed pollination in two flower beds and recorded daily visitor counts. A sharp fluctuation on one windy morning tempted her to announce that one bed no longer attracted insects. Her teacher suggested comparing discrete daily records with the cumulative total for the whole week. The windy morning remained part of the data, but it did not represent every day. Looking at both short-term changes and the longer pattern helped her describe the results without turning one unusual observation into a general rule.

question.promptKo: 교사가 일별 기록과 일주일 합계를 함께 보라고 한 이유는?
choices: 두 화단이 완전히 같다고 미리 결론 내리도록
곤충 수를 더 이상 세지 않도록
하루의 특이한 관찰을 전체 경향으로 단정하지 않도록
바람이 분 날의 기록을 반드시 삭제하도록
question.explanationKo: 하루의 급격한 변화도 보존하되 더 긴 기간의 자료와 비교하면 과도한 일반화를 피할 수 있습니다.
question.evidenceQuote: Looking at both short-term changes and the longer pattern helped her describe the results without turning one unusual observation into a general rule.
